jobs.title: HFA Program Specialist
jobs.description:
HilltopSecurities is currently looking to hire an HFA Program Specialist in our Sherman Oaks office. The HFA Program Specialist is responsible for performing the department’s pre\- and / or post\-closing compliance review for client TBA and MRB/MCC programs. The Specialist works under minimal supervision with encouragement to exercise initiative and independent judgement.


  
* Ability to learn the Emphasys Loan Tracking system flow and functionalities as well as the online reservation system, Lender Online.
* Possess a moderate working knowledge of agency and Servicer guidelines as they relate to the program, and the ability to research when clarity is needed.
* General knowledge of mortgage industry rules and regulations a must.
* Experience with processing mortgage loans is highly preferred.
* Technical knowledge and experience with state and local housing agency programs is preferred.
* Accustomed to working in a fast\-paced, team\-oriented environment.
* Ability to provide exceptional customer service and establish a friendly rapport with participating lenders, borrowers, and clients.
* Proficiency in the use of Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook.
* Strong communications skills, both oral and written and effective interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work well independently and prioritize tasks.
* Must be detail oriented, organized, and keep up with the often\-demanding pace of the workload
* High level of integrity and dependability with a strong sense of urgency and results oriented.
* Must be flexible for overtime if required to meet deadlines.
* Assist with other projects as needed with a can\-do attitude.

  
**Essential Functions:**

* Ensure that prompt review of loan applications and supporting documentation is performed by adhering to stated program timelines, and that documentation submitted meets applicable program requirements.
* Perform income calculations using paystubs, tax returns and other supporting documents for loan program compliance.
* Provide direct assistance to lender and issuer questions related to program documents, requirements, and processes.
* Monitor program pipelines by routine follow up emails/phone calls to lenders and communicates concisely any missing/incomplete documents in order to meet program and timeline requirements.
* Perform program commitment expiration extensions, loan changes and cancellation requests as directed by the lender.
* Keep current with all department clients, programs, guidelines, and processes.
* Identify process improvements with documentation of such as applicable.
* Cross train in other roles to provide back\-up support to other team members as needed, specifically as back up to the accounting functions as well as phone coverage.
* Provide prompt customer service by monitoring personal and individual program email inboxes as needed and responding via email or phone.
* Follow the lender on\-boarding process for access to Lender Online.
* Maintain an accurate list of participating lenders and creates user credentials.
* Assist Lenders with maneuvering through the flow of the online reservation system via the web portals.

jobs.title: Research Program Specialist
jobs.description:
In order for your application to be considered, please attached a cover letter and CV to your employment application.

**Position Description**


The Schaeffer Institute is seeking a **Research Program Specialist** to provide high\-level administrative leadership for the USC Mann Department of Pharmaceutical \& Health Economics, and to take on new programmatic support for the Institute leadership team and its growing modeling research program. Working with established and up\-and\-coming scholars, the **Research Program Specialist** will develop and spearhead new procedures and processes to support an in\-demand research team and their work with sophisticated data and modeling tools developed at the Institute. The **Research Program Specialist** will assist in program development and ensure that deadlines and milestones are met. The position will report to the Schaeffer Institute Director of Operations (in coordination with respective departmental leadership), who will help oversee the portfolio of work and ensure a collaborative and creative work environment across teams. The right candidate will contribute ideas, identify opportunities, and help shape priorities to ensure leadership and program success.


This position offers a unique opportunity in the substantive work of a policy research center and an important academic department. The right candidate will have administrative expertise, high attention to detail, and enthusiasm for supporting a robust research agenda, faculty activities, and student engagement. The Schaeffer Institute serves a varied group of internal and external constituents—including students, academics, executives, philanthropists, and leading policymakers and staffers—across the political spectrum. Demonstrated experience working with leading faculty and scholars to support research goals is a plus.

**Research Program Leadership**

* Coordinate administrative functions for the modeling research program and other research initiatives as directed by Schaeffer leadership, including acting as a point of contact, responding to requests and inquiries, and managing program content.
* Assist program leadership and key stakeholders with anaylsis, research, and presentations.
* Manage program deadlines; coordinating and tracking grants, projects, and timelines to ensure deliverables and milestones are met.
* Support reporting and proposal development, including budget tracking, grant submissions, and compliance processes.
* Coordinate and contribute to research studies, proposals, and grant\-related research activities.
* Contribute to administrative leadership team meetings and support to Schaeffer academic and policy programming as time allows.

**Department Leadership**

* Oversee Department Chair’s administrative duties by managing calendars, coordinating meetings, preparing course materials, and assisting with day\-to\-day departmental operations for leading faculty.
* Organize departmental events, including conferences, seminars, special events and faculty meetings by managing logistics, vendor communications, facilities, catering, guest accommodations, and event execution.
* Collaborate with the USC Mann communications department to maintain and update the department website, ensuring accurate content, multimedia displays, and compliance with program policies.
* Execute two full\-cycle faculty recruitment searches by arranging candidate travel, accommodations, campus itineraries, interview schedules, and job talks; contributing to the successful hiring of two junior faculty members.
* Lead academic program services and activities including course scheduling, student recruitment initiatives, student summer programs, graduate program’s brown bag series, prospective student visit days, and new student orientation.
* Support graduate students’ academic progress by coordinating dissertation defenses, including scheduling, room reservations, logistics, technology setup, and day\-of\-event coordination to ensure successful execution.
* Act as the liaison between graduate students and the GAO, facilitating effective communication and ensuring students receive accurate information and support throughout their time in the program.
* Manage department faculty, students, and Schaeffer Center member travel, travel reimbursements.
* Process journal publication fees, manuscript edits, and purchase research materials while ensuring compliance with university policies and procedures.

**Minimum Education:**


Bachelor’s degree

**Minimum Experience:**


2 years of relevant experience

**Compensation**


Commensurate with experience and qualifications. Position is 100% FTE


Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The university reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.


The hourly rate range for this position is $40\.95 \- $46\.28\. When extending an offer of employment, the University of Southern California considers factors such as (but not limited to) the scope and responsibilities of the position, the candidate’s work experience, education/training, key skills, internal peer equity, federal, state and local laws, contractual stipulations, grant funding, as well as external market and organizational considerations.

**Work Arrangement**


Expected to work onsite 2\-3 days per week at USC University Park Campus in Los Angeles, CA

**Fixed Term Position**


This is a full time, fixed term position through June 30, 2029 (with the possibility of renewal) with a hybrid work arrangement

**About the USC Schaeffer Institute**


The USC Schaeffer Institute for Public Policy \& Government Service develops evidence\-based solutions to address the nation’s most pressing policy issues. It serves as a policy laboratory to develop and test ideas generated by the USC academic community, fosters civic engagement, and provides a forum to reach federal policymakers.


Established by an historic gift from Leonard D. Schaeffer in 2024, the USC Schaeffer Institute inc

jobs.title: Operations Coordinator, Autonomy Systems Validation (2nd Shift)
jobs.description:
Our Autonomy Systems Validation’s team is expanding, and we are looking for a skilled Site Coordinator with a focus on autonomous vehicle testing, data collection, and integration of development hardware and software. In this role, you will be responsible for planning, coordinating, and leading a team of vehicle operators. This involves a team testing on public roads and private facilities, executing safety protocols, and performing specialized test procedures. You’ll also work with hardware and software engineering teams as needed to help achieve strategic goals.  

* Coordinate project requirements and scheduling, ensuring sufficient coverage.
* Assign test routes and vehicles to vehicle operators based on vehicle availability and test plan.
* Act as the primary point of contact on\-site for the vehicle operator team.
* Implement processes, procedures and work instructions.
* Collaborate with engineering to achieve strategic goals.
* Prepare training materials and assist in onboarding new vehicle operators.
* Motivate vehicle operators to reach objectives and maintain high performance and safety standards.
* Maintain vehicle operator relations, resolve conflicts and foster a positive, productive and professional work environment.
* Ensure test / route schedules are maintained by monitoring driving habits, implementing procedures and/or equipment as required.
* Set key operational performance indicators to measure success and perform data analytics.
* Develop and manage detailed operational reports, dashboards and tools to report results in an accurate and timely manner.
* Ensure essential tools and equipment are well\-organized and easily accessible.
* Perform vehicle inspections to ensure safety, functionality and cleanliness. Perform initial troubleshooting, hardware and software issue investigation and software updating.
* Oversee the transfer of the drive data from the vehicle to the cloud/servers.
* Must be able to work 1st Shift (6:00a \- 2:30p)

  

* Previous supervisory experience, preferably in an professional automotive driving or autonomous vehicle testing experience.
* Flexible and able to perform various tasks as requested.
* Self\-motivated, organized, and capable of good judgment in a fast\-paced, high\-stress environment.
* Attention to detail, excellent written and verbal communication skills and ability to describe events quickly and concisely.
* Proficiency using a smartphone, laptop, and Google tools (Docs, Sheets, Maps).
* Must be flexible to work overtime as needed.
* Must be flexible to travel as needed.
* Must be able to lift up to 50 pounds.
* Minimum age of 21\.
* No driving related suspensions or revocation of Driver License (within a 3\-5 year period).
* No drug or alcohol related driving incidents in the last 3 years.
* No more than 1 serious moving violation in the last 3 years.
* Must have a valid driver's license in the state of residence that you will be driving/operating a vehicle.
* Will be subject to continuous Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) monitoring.


Bonus* Experience with Atlassian products.
* Proficiency in troubleshooting and debugging software and hardware programs in vehicles.

jobs.title: Logistics Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Overview**

We are seeking a dynamic and detail\-oriented Logistics Operations Coordinator to join our supply chain team. In this pivotal role, you will oversee the efficient management of warehouse distribution, transportation planning, and inventory control processes. Your expertise will ensure seamless coordination across multiple departments, optimize logistics workflows, and drive continuous process improvements. This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to a fast\-paced environment where proactive problem\-solving and cross\-functional collaboration are key to success.

**Responsibilities**

* Coordinate warehouse operations including shipping, receiving, stocking, and materials handling to ensure timely order fulfillment and inventory accuracy.
* Manage transportation logistics using transportation management systems (TMS) and ERP platforms to optimize freight routes, costs, and delivery schedules.
* Oversee procurement activities such as sourcing suppliers, negotiating pricing, and managing vendor relationships to secure cost\-effective materials and services.
* Conduct data analysis utilizing tools like SQL, Excel, and Tableau to monitor supply chain performance metrics, identify root causes of issues, and recommend process improvements.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams on demand planning, production scheduling, and category management to align inventory levels with forecasted demand.
* Ensure compliance with international trade regulations and trade compliance standards for import/export activities.
* Lead initiatives for process improvement in warehouse management systems (WMS), inventory management systems (IMS), and related software to enhance operational efficiency.

**Qualifications**

* Proven experience practicing in a supply chain operations or logistics role with a strong understanding of warehouse management, transportation planning, and materials handling.
* Proficiency in ERP systems such as AS400 or SAP, Warehouse Management System (WMS), Inventory Management Systems (IMS), and transportation management systems (TMS).
* Strong data analysis skills using Excel (including data collection and analysis), SQL, Tableau or similar tools for supply chain analytics.
* Knowledge of international trade regulations, trade compliance standards, and NVOCC (Non\-Vessel Operating Common Carrier) operations.
* Ability to negotiate effectively with vendors and suppliers while managing procurement processes.
* Skilled in freight management, shipping \& receiving procedures, 3PL (third\-party logistics) coordination, and transportation logistics.
* Excellent communication skills for cross\-functional collaboration and customer service excellence.
* Forklift certification or experience operating warehouse equipment is preferred but not mandatory.

Join us as a Logistics Operations Coordinator to be at the forefront of supply chain excellence! Your expertise will help streamline operations, reduce costs, and elevate our service levels—all while working in a vibrant environment that values innovation and teamwork.

Pay: $3,500\.00 \- $5,000\.00 per month

Work Location: In person

jobs.description:
**About Home From College**
---------------------------


Home From College (H\\FC) is redefining how brands connect with the next generation of talent and consumers. With over 500,000 Gen Z students across every major U.S. campus and 1,000\+ brand partners including Uber, Poppi, and Etsy, we're building the leading platform where students turn creativity into opportunity—and where brands authentically show up on campus and online.


Backed by Google Ventures and leading investors, we're in a stage of rapid growth and are looking for a Customer Success Coordinator to help scale the operational engine behind every campaign we run. This role sits on the Customer Success team with close partnership across GTM, Sales, and Product.

**The Role**
------------


We're seeking a Customer Success Coordinator to keep brand accounts moving — owning the day\-to\-day execution that gets students recruited, work reviewed, and campaigns delivered on time.


This role is the operational core of how H\\FC delivers for brands. You'll review submissions against brand briefs, recruit and follow up with student participants, collect and verify live content links, and build the tasks that turn a brand brief into completed work. It's high\-volume, fast\-turnaround, and standards\-driven: when it's done well, students get paid on time, brands see momentum, and the CS team stays focused on relationships and growth.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

* **microGIG Submission Review:** Review student submissions against the brief and approve, request revisions, or reject. Apply consistent quality standards and flag edge cases to CS rather than guessing.
* **Participant Recruiting:** Source and invite students into open microGIGs based on brand fit and requirements. Follow up with students who haven't accepted or started, and backfill drop\-offs to keep GIGs fully staffed.
* **Content Link Collection:** Chase and confirm live links for published content across platforms. Verify links are live, correct, and attached to the right submission, and escalate unresponsive students after standard follow\-up.
* **Task Creation \& Management:** Build and assign participant tasks from brand briefs. Keep task details, deadlines, and deliverables accurate in the platform, and update or close tasks as scope shifts.
* **Account Support \& Risk Flagging:** Keep account records and trackers current. Surface risks early — stalled GIGs, unresponsive participants, brands going quiet — so CS hears about problems from you, not from the brand.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

* 1–3 years of experience in operations, coordination, customer support, or community management — ideally at a marketplace, creator platform, or high\-growth consumer company.
* Extremely reliable and responsive; this role is critical for student payouts and brand deadlines.
* Strong written communication — a lot of this job is clear follow\-up with students and brands.
* Detail\-oriented and genuinely comfortable with repetitive, checklist\-driven work at scale.
* Good judgment on when to decide and when to escalate.
* Comfortable in a dashboard, spreadsheets, Slack, and within AI tools.
* Bonus: experience with creator or influencer programs, marketplace operations, or campus and student communities.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* Competitive annual base compensation
* Health, Dental, and Vision Insurance
* 401(k) Plan

jobs.description:
We are seeking a dynamic individual to join our premium medical practice for the role of Administrative and Clinical Coordinator. This practice is heavily oriented to elective (non\-insurance) premium services for vision correction. Patients are seen in a concierge\-level environment. The ideal candidate will project positivity in all interactions, ensuring they treat all patients and co\-workers with dignity and respect, and will enjoy working with and improving the lives of our patients. Candidates with previous sales experience and/or a desire to communicate value to patients who are paying out of pocket for outstanding surgical outcomes is a plus. Some medical office experience is desirable, although high\-level customer service experience may be substituted. The position is required to be in the office, but there are some days when there is opportunity to work from home.

Clinical responsibilities:

· Perform patient work\-ups, including documenting reason for visit, history of present illness, current medications, and some additional medical history in the electronic health record (EHR)

· Perform diagnostic testing including but not limited to, optical coherence tomography (OCT), fundus photography, Humphrey visual filed analyzer (HFA), lensometer, auto\-refractor

· Instill ophthalmic drops per physicians orders

· Provide medical products to patients as directed by physician

· Clean and maintain instruments and equipment, arranging for maintenance, repair, or calibration as necessary

· Turn on and set up machines in the mornings, shut down and cover machines at end of clinic

· Perform online consulations

· Communicate any delays to the patient in a timely manner

· Communicate with front desk staff remain appraised of clinic patient volume status

· Treat patient information with confidentiality, maintaining HIPAA compliance

· Perform other clinical duties as assigned by the physician

Administrative responsibilities

· Subsequent to patient/physician consultation, meet with patient to answer questions, schedule surgery, document same on customer relationship management (CRM) and EHR

· Submit appropriate orders and paperwork timely to the ASC (ambulatory surgery center)

· Review surgical consents with patient, obtain necessary sign

· Attend local ASC to provide support to patients and collect outstanding fees on surgery days

· Use CRM software to identify existing and new patients to schedule consults and appointments

· Cross\-train on front desk duties to provide coverage when necessary

· Perform other duties as assigned by physician and practice administrator

jobs.title: SSL Ticket Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
About Hollywood Park
Hollywood Park is a premier, nearly 300\-acre global sports and entertainment destination in Inglewood, California. Owned, operated, and being developed by Los Angeles Rams Owner/Chairman E. Stanley Kroenke, it stands as the largest urban mixed\-use development currently under construction in the Western United States. The vibrant "city within a city" features sophisticated residences, a dynamic outdoor retail and lifestyle district, creative office spaces, public parks, and a scenic lake. Anchored by the world\-class SoFi Stadium and YouTube Theater, with Hollywood Park Studios and a luxury boutique hotel forthcoming, the district creates the ultimate Live, Work, Play environment.
  

  

Home to the Los Angeles Chargers and Super Bowl LVI Champion Los Angeles Rams, the 3\.1 million\-square\-foot SoFi Stadium is the NFL’s largest venue, and the first indoor\-outdoor stadium. It seats approximately 70,000, expandable to 100,000, with more than 260 luxury suites and over 13,000 premium seats. A proven global leader that consistently ranks among the world’s top venues in ticket sales, the stadium has already hosted iconic events like eight FIFA World Cup 2026 matches, Super Bowl LVI, the 2023 College Football National Championship, WrestleMania 39, the CONCACAF Gold Cup Final, and numerous record\-breaking concerts. SoFi Stadium is set to host the Super Bowl LXI in 2027, the Olympic and Paralympic Opening Ceremonies for the 2028 Olympic and Paralympic Games (LA28\), along with being converted into the largest Olympic swimming venue in history.  

  

Adjacent to the stadium and under the same sweeping translucent roof canopy sits the 2\.5\-acre open\-air American Airlines Plaza and the 6,000\-seat YouTube Theater. As an intimate, state\-of\-the\-art venue, YouTube Theater hosts a diverse line\-up of chart\-topping superstars, iconic comedy acts, awards shows, esports competitions, community gatherings, and corporate conferences. Named the “Top West Coast Club or Theater” by Billboard, YouTube Theater is a must\-play destination.  

  

Culture  

  

Hollywood Park is being brought to life by a deeply experienced team of creative forward\-thinkers. The project is a celebration of all that Los Angeles has to offer. We are inspired by our diverse Inglewood community as a place for the community to be, to see and to connect.
Hollywood Park is committed to building and maintaining a workplace that celebrates the diversity of our team members, allowing them to bring their authentic selves to work every day.  

  

At the heart of Hollywood Park, lies our dedication to our purpose, promise, and commitments. Our **PURPOSE** is creating extraordinary experiences, one moment at a time. Our **PROMISE** is to be an iconic destination that celebrates our diverse and vibrant community. We promise to exceed expectations while cultivating a fun and safe experience where lasting memories are made. Our **COMMITMENTS** are outlined by **S.T.A.R.S.**  

  

 Our **S.T.A.R.S.** commitments are enabled by five foundational principles:
* Start with Care – create a lasting impact through genuine care
* Thrive as a Team – create an environment of collaboration and encouragement
* Anticipate Unspoken Needs – be proactive in delivering extraordinary service and supporting others
* Resolve with Respect – treat others with empathy, patience, and kindness
* Safety Always – maintain a safe and secure environment.

As The SSL Ticket Operations Coordinator, You Will…
Reporting to the Manager of SSL \& Ticket Operations, the Coordinator will be primarily focused on processing SSL (Stadium Seat License) transactions, handling collections, and maintaining database integrity.
More Specific Responsiblities Include, But are Not Limited To...
* Primary responsibility is to handle SSL collections outreach, customer service and default notifications
* Process SSL deposits and payments for SSL holders
* Responsible for creating, verifying, and processing refinance, transfer, and termination contracts
* Approve, countersign and process all SSL transfers
* Sell on specific year’s default event to keep track of outstanding balances in future years for both SSL and season ticket member clients
* Calculate interest for accounts who would like to pay their SSL in full
* Interact with both the Rams and Chargers for account updates as needed
* Assist in annual invoice setup

We'd Love to Hear from People With...
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience
* 1\+ year working in a sports/entertainment environment preferred
* Team player with ability to work accurately and independently
* Strong attention to detail
* Experience with Google Suite, Microsoft Office, \& Archtics is a plus
* Ability to manage time and multiple tasks

Compensation: $25\.00 \- $32\.00 per hour  

Location: Inglewood, CA (On\-site)  

  

In compliance with the California Pay Transparency Act, compensation information provided is a good faith estimate for this position only. Hollywood Park considers a candidate’s education, certification, prior experience, as well as internal and external data when determining the salary level for potential new employees. Only in exceptional circumstances, if an external candidate has the experience, credentials, or expertise far exceeding what is expected for the position, would Hollywood Park consider paying a salary or rate near the higher end of the range.  

  

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time.

jobs.title: National Retail Sales Manager or Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
The National Retail Sales Manager owns Traveler's Choice's retail account relationships end to end. This person is the primary point of contact between TC and its retail buyers, responsible for selling in seasonal assortments, negotiating pricing and programs, and managing each account's performance against revenue and margin targets. Beyond selling what exists today, this role feeds buyer insights and market needs back to the product and design teams so TC is developing the right products for each channel. The position requires someone who can operate independently across multiple accounts and retail formats, build presentations that win shelf space, and protect brand integrity as products move through different tiers of distribution.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Achieve annual revenue targets across assigned retail accounts
* Maintain or grow door count and SKU placement at each account
* Deliver gross margin targets by account, managing pricing and promotional allowances within approved guidelines
* Seasonal sell\-in execution: present and close seasonal product assortments on time per each retailer's buying calendar
* Forecast accuracy within defined threshold (e.g., ±10%) on monthly and quarterly shipment projections
* Buyer communication: maintain regular contact cadence with each account's buying team, including scheduled check\-ins, post\-season recaps, and proactive updates on product availability and opportunities
* Product development input: translate buyer feedback and account\-specific needs into actionable product briefs for the design and sourcing teams, contributing to assortment planning that aligns with each retailer's customer and price architecture
* Presentation quality and execution: build and deliver polished, account\-tailored product presentations and line reviews that clearly communicate value proposition, competitive positioning, and margin story for each program
* Inventory sell\-through tracking: partner with buyers to minimize markdowns and returns
* On\-time submission of all account\-required documentation (item setup forms, compliance paperwork, routing guides)

**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of sales experience calling on national or regional retail accounts (mass, department, specialty, off\-price, or club channels)
* Demonstrated track record managing multiple retail accounts simultaneously with full\-cycle ownership: product selection, pricing, presentation, negotiation, and post\-sale follow\-through
* Understanding of how different retail channels operate, including inline programs, planogram/modular sets, off\-price opportunistic buys, and promotional cycles
* Experience managing brand positioning across channels, with sensitivity to how pricing and placement in one channel affects brand equity in others
* Proficiency in building and delivering product presentations and line reviews tailored to individual buyer needs
* Strong analytical skills: ability to read sell\-through reports, POS data, and inventory positions to inform account strategy
* Comfortable with travel to buyer offices, trade shows, and retailer HQs as needed
* Bachelor's degree required

Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $120,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Employee discount
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Your design eye will help you speak confidently with clients and understand what makes a home marketable.

* **Highly motivated and sales\-driven**

Experience in **real estate, home staging, interior design, furniture, luxury sales, hospitality, recruiting, or business development** is a plus.

If you are someone who can walk into a real estate office, confidently introduce yourself, start a conversation with an agent, build a relationship, and ultimately turn that relationship into business—you may be exactly who we're looking for.

This position offers a **competitive compensation structure with commission and significant earning potential based on sales performance.**

The opportunity is ideal for someone who wants their income to reflect their effort and success.

* Work with a recognized leader in Southern California's home\-staging industry
* Build relationships with **high\-producing real estate professionals**
* Work around luxury homes and beautiful interiors
* Opportunity for significant commission and sales growth
* Be part of a creative, fast\-paced, entrepreneurial environment

READY TO MAKE AN IMPACT?

If you are **a salesperson at heart, love design and real estate, and are hungry to build a book of business**, we want to hear from you.

**Elite Home Staging is looking for someone who doesn't wait for business to come to them—they go out and create it.**

**This role is designed for a high\-potential bilingual professional who wants to grow across operations, business development, and eventually management.**

***About the Role***

ADM Tech is looking for a highly organized, resourceful, and business\-minded bilingual professional to join our Orange County office.

This is a cross\-functional role working closely with the CEO and serving as a central point of coordination across our U.S. and China teams, business development, sales, customer service, operations, HR, vendors, and external business partners.

**This is not a traditional Executive Assistant or Administrative Assistant position.**

Routine assistant\-style tasks — such as scheduling, basic administrative follow\-up, and occasional travel or meeting coordination — represent only a small portion of the role, typically averaging approximately **20–30 minutes per day**, depending on business needs.

The core of this position is to help **organize, coordinate, communicate, move projects forward, develop new business opportunities, and gradually take on greater operational and management responsibilities.**

We are not looking to develop someone into a long\-term Executive Assistant. Instead, this role is designed as a potential **management development track** for a high\-potential individual who may grow into a **Manager and, over time, potentially senior management or Vice President\-level responsibilities**, based on performance, capability, leadership potential, and the needs of the business.

Professional fluency in both **Mandarin Chinese and English is required**, as the position involves frequent communication between U.S.\-based and China\-based colleagues, customers, partners, factories, and vendors.

***Key Responsibilities***

Cross\-Functional Coordination \& Project Management

Serve as an organizer and coordinator across multiple areas of the company.

Help coordinate and move forward projects involving the U.S. team, China\-based teams, senior management, vendors, customers, and external partners.

Track priorities, deadlines, open items, and action points to ensure important matters are followed through to completion.

Facilitate communication across departments, countries, and time zones, helping resolve misunderstandings, identify next steps, and keep projects moving.

Organize information from different stakeholders and turn it into clear action plans, summaries, reports, or follow\-up items.

Support the CEO and management team in coordinating new initiatives, operational projects, and changing business priorities.

***Business Development \& Growth Initiatives***

Actively participate in identifying and developing new business opportunities rather than serving only as an internal support function.

Research prospective customers, distributors, retailers, channel partners, suppliers, and strategic opportunities.

Support or participate directly in outreach to prospective customers and business partners.

Prepare professional outreach emails, presentations, proposals, quotations, line cards, sales materials, and follow\-up communications.

Assist with customer meetings, business presentations, product demonstrations, samples, trade shows, and channel development projects.

Conduct market, competitor, customer, and industry research and turn findings into actionable business recommendations.

Maintain and organize business development pipelines and customer information using CRM and related systems.

As experience grows, take increasing ownership of selected accounts, projects, business opportunities, or partnerships.

***Operations \& Management Development***

Gradually become involved in broader company operations and selected management responsibilities.

Help identify operational problems, inefficiencies, or communication gaps and assist in developing practical solutions.

Support the creation and improvement of internal processes, workflows, documentation, and accountability systems.

Coordinate priorities and follow\-ups across sales, customer service, operations, administration, and other functions.

jobs.description:
Imagine working for a dynamic, technology\-driven HOA management company that is rapidly expanding, offering abundant opportunities for career advancement, and fostering a company culture that genuinely supports its team members.




RealManage has earned the prestigious Certified™ recognition from **Great Place to Work**®, a global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and leadership excellence. This accolade is a testament to the positive feedback from our employees about their RealManage experience.




At RealManage, we deeply value your professionalism and dedication. We are dedicated to ensuring your long\-term career success and consider you not just an employee, but a valued member of our family.




Join us at RealManage and be part of a thriving environment where growth, innovation, and supportive teamwork define our everyday operations.




**Company Overview:**


RealManage is a prominent national firm recognized on the Inc. 5000 list, operating across 16 states \+ Washington DC and serving a diverse array of clients including homeowners’ associations (HOAs), condominium associations, cooperatives, luxury high\-rises, municipal utility districts, and master\-planned communities. Our client base also includes nationally renowned developer and builder clients.


Ranked among the top firms in the community management industry (\#3 out of 5,000\+), RealManage distinguishes itself by delivering exceptional solutions at competitive prices. We leverage cutting\-edge cloud\-based technologies and mobile apps, supported by industry\-leading practices and a highly skilled workforce.


Our mission at RealManage is to offer comprehensive and innovative solutions that consistently surpass customer expectations. We prioritize transparency and visibility in all client interactions, continuously measuring our performance to achieve rapid improvement. We foster a workplace culture that promotes professionalism, encourages growth, and embraces diversity. By maintaining financial strength and focusing on continual innovation, we aim to lead the industry with pioneering advancements.


Join RealManage and contribute to a company dedicated to excellence, innovation, and delivering unparalleled service in community management.


RealManage is a values\-based company with the following values as our guiding principles:

* **Integrity:** we always do the right thing.
* **Respect:** for our customers, employees and company; mutual respect is the cornerstone for every RealManage relationship.
* **Selflessness:** more than teamwork; we are part of something special and much larger than any of us.
* **Personal Relationships:** we are a professional services company; people do business with people they like.
* **Always Improving:** never satisfied, always learning and always growing; one is either getting worse or getting better...never staying the same. At RealManage, we are always getting better.




The **Assistant Community Association Manager (ACAM)** assists in the management of daily operations of community associations delivering professional services and exceptional customer satisfaction in accordance with the service level agreement, and in alignment with the company’s guiding principles.




**Responsibilities:**

	+ Respond to resident inquiries (calls/emails) within 24 hours.
	+ Maintain knowledge of state regulations, community policies, and governing documents.
	+ Upload and archive official community documents.
	+ Support communication related to violations

	+ Build positive resident relationships; promote excellent customer service.
	+ Attend required team and training meetings.
	+ Perform other duties as assigned.




* Must have own vehicle, clean driving record.
* + Strong customer service, communication, and organizational skills.
	+ Proficient in Microsoft Office; able to learn quickly and retain information.
	+ High integrity and ability to handle confidential information.
	+ Able to multitask, manage shifting priorities, and work independently or with a team.

**Pay and Benefits:**


$25\.00 to $29\.00, depending on education and experience.




**Benefits include:**

* Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Vision Insurance
* Life and Disability Insurance

* FSA

jobs.title: B2B Outside Sales Representative
jobs.description:
Every day, Global Payments makes it possible for millions of people to move money between buyers and sellers using our payments solutions for credit, debit, prepaid and merchant services. Our worldwide team helps over 3 million companies, more than 1,300 financial institutions and over 600 million cardholders grow with confidence and achieve amazing results. We are driven by our passion for success and we are proud to deliver best\-in\-class payment technology and software solutions. Join our dynamic team and make your mark on the payments technology landscape of tomorrow.


**Ready to take your career global?**


Make your mark with one of the biggest names in payments. At Global Payments, you help businesses grow by transforming how they accept and manage payments. As a B2B Outside Sales Representative on the Genius® team, you bring innovative solutions directly to business owners and create a real, measurable impact on their day\-to\-day operations.


You will join a team powered by energy, curiosity, and shared success. You will learn from experienced people leaders, build meaningful connections, and grow your career in a global business that is always evolving. Every conversation you lead and every relationship you build moves the future of commerce forward.


In this role, you’ll drive new business, shape client success and own outcomes that increase revenue, improve operations, and create long\-term value. You will lead the full sales cycle, influence decision\-making and bring the power of Genius® to life for businesses across your market.

**What you’ll own**

* Drive new business growth by creating opportunities through field outreach, digital engagement and local networking
* Own the full sales cycle, turning conversations into revenue and delivering consistent results in your territory
* Build trusted relationships with business owners, positioning yourself as a go\-to advisor who understands their goals
* Deliver compelling, value\-driven presentations that show how Genius® improves operations, increases loyalty and fuels growth
* Shape your territory strategy using market insights, strengthening your pipeline and accelerating deal momentum
* Expand Global Payments’ impact by introducing innovative solutions that help businesses operate smarter and grow faster
* Strengthen long\-term client value by identifying opportunities to expand solutions and deepen relationships
* Spend up to 75% of your time in the field, creating meaningful, face\-to\-face connections that drive results

**What you bring**

* At least one year of success in B2B or business\-to\-consumer (B2C) outside sales, with a track record of delivering results
* Strong ability to communicate, present and negotiate, both in person and virtually
* Confidence building relationships quickly and earning trust with business owners
* A competitive, self\-driven mindset with the energy to achieve and exceed goals
* Ability to think like a client and connect solutions to real business outcomes
* Valid driver’s license and comfort spending up to 75% of your time in the field
* Residence within two hours of the territory to stay connected and responsive

**It’s a bonus if you have**

* A proven ability to upsell and cross\-sell existing merchants on new features, software add\-ons, and hardware upgrades.
* Experience working with the restaurant or retail industries is a plus.
* Two full years of B2B Outside Sales experience, preferably in fintech, merchant services or Saas.

**Our perks \- what we’ll bring for you**


We know it’s bigger than just your career. It’s your life and your world. That’s why we offer global benefits and programs to support you at every stage. Here’s a taste of what you can expect.  

* A competitive salary and benefits package that recognizes your contribution
* Opportunities to grow your skills and build your career within a global business
* Access to learning, development and on\-the\-job experiences that expand your expertise
* A supportive, inclusive team environment where your ideas and input matter
* Time to give back through community and charity initiatives
* A global employee assistance program to support your wellbeing
* Recognition through a global platform that celebrates your achievements.

https://jobs.globalpayments.com/en/why\-global\-payments/benefits/

 **What makes a Globalpayer?**


Globalpayers think like a client, act like an owner and win as one team. We’re curious and innovative – always finding better ways to deliver impact. We empower each other to make decisions, and it’s our passion that drives excellence in everything we set out to do.


Come and be part of an ever\-evolving company and get dynamic opportunities that go beyond borders.


Does this sound like you? Then you sound like a Globalpayer. Apply now to take your career global.

**Benefits**


Global Payments offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, retirement programs, charitable gift matching, and more. Learn more at Global Payments Benefits.


Diversity and EEO Statements


Global Payments is an organization that stands against racism, intolerance and injustice in all its forms — one that respects, honors and celebrates the diversity of our team members and the differences among us. Our commitment to fostering a company culture that values and respects Inclusion and Diversity is steadfast. Standing together as one company, we will continue to work to drive positive change for the communities in which we live and work and stamp out injustice.


Global Payments is an equal opportunity employer. Global Payments provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, disability, veteran status, genetic information or any other basis protected by law. jobs.title: Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
**Saddleback Lanes** is a well\-established bowling and entertainment center serving the Mission Viejo community. We provide a welcoming environment for casual bowling, leagues, group events, birthday parties, arcade entertainment, dining, and other social activities.

We are seeking a dependable, organized, and customer\-focused **Operations Assistant** to support our day\-to\-day operations. This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in an active environment, communicates well with others, and is comfortable handling a variety of operational and customer service responsibilities.

Position Overview

The **Operations Assistant** helps ensure daily activities throughout the facility run smoothly, efficiently, and professionally. This position provides support with guest services, event preparation, operational supplies, facility organization, administrative tasks, and coordination between team members.

The ideal candidate is reliable, detail\-oriented, adaptable, and able to manage multiple priorities in a busy entertainment environment. Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, entertainment, or general operations is helpful but not required. Training will be provided for the right candidate.

Key Responsibilities

* Support daily operations throughout the bowling and entertainment center
* Assist guests with general questions, directions, and basic service needs
* Help coordinate bowling activities, reservations, leagues, parties, and group events
* Assist with preparing areas for birthday parties, corporate events, and other scheduled activities
* Communicate with team members to help ensure events and reservations are prepared on time
* Monitor operational areas and report maintenance, equipment, or service issues
* Assist with organizing operational supplies, equipment, and materials
* Help receive, organize, and distribute supplies as needed
* Maintain accurate basic records, checklists, and operational documentation
* Assist with tracking inventory levels of frequently used supplies and materials
* Support opening, closing, and shift transition procedures as assigned
* Help maintain clean, organized, and guest\-ready common areas
* Coordinate with front desk, food service, event, and facility staff as needed
* Respond professionally to routine guest questions and concerns
* Follow established company procedures and workplace safety guidelines
* Assist management with general administrative and operational tasks
* Perform additional duties as needed to support smooth daily operations

Qualifications

* Previous experience in customer service, hospitality, entertainment, administrative support, or operations is preferred but not required
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail
* Friendly and professional communication skills
* Ability to work effectively in a busy, customer\-facing environment
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and changing priorities
* Dependable attendance and punctuality
* Basic computer and data\-entry skills
* Ability to follow written and verbal instructions
* Comfortable working independently and as part of a team
* Positive, flexible, and service\-oriented attitude
* Willingness to learn different areas of facility operations

Physical Requirements

* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods
* Ability to move throughout different areas of the facility during the shift
* Ability to bend, reach, carry, and perform light physical tasks as needed
* Ability to assist with moving supplies, event materials, and equipment safely

What We Offer

* Training and support for job\-specific responsibilities
* Friendly and team\-oriented work environment
* Opportunity to gain experience in entertainment and hospitality operations
* Variety of customer service and operational responsibilities
* Opportunity to learn multiple areas of the business
* Potential for additional responsibilities and professional growth

Join Our Team

At **Saddleback Lanes**, creating a positive guest experience depends on teamwork, organization, and dependable daily operations. Our Operations Assistant helps keep activities coordinated, supports our team, and contributes to a welcoming environment for every guest.

If you are organized, dependable, customer\-focused, and enjoy working in an active and social environment, we encourage you to apply for our **Operations Assistant** position.

Pay: $20\.30 \- $24\.40 per hour

Expected hours: 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Employee assistance program
* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Professional development assistance
* Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Community Manager
jobs.description:
FDC Management, Inc. is seeking an energetic, resourceful self\-starter to serve as the Community Manager at Los Arbolitos Apartments in Huntington Beach, California. We are looking for a professional with a strong work ethic who consistently takes initiative. At our company, continuing professional development is a must. Through self\-study, peer mentors, in\-house training, and paid professional education, we keep our skills sharp and our knowledge current.

The ideal candidate will demonstrate extensive experience and a genuine interest in maintaining and improving the physical property, developing effective teams, navigating legal and contractual issues, and maximizing long\-term rental income.

**Schedule:** Tuesday – Saturday, 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM

**Compensation:** $35\.00 – $39\.00 / hour (Based on industry certification, experience, and formal education)

**General Expectations**

* Operation of an FDC community requires teamwork, coordination, and cooperation from all members of the on\-site staff.
* Every employee should be prepared to assist co\-workers with priority tasks.
* All employees are responsible for keeping the property clean, quiet, orderly, and in good repair.
* All employees may be required to work weekends, holidays, and overtime.

**Core Responsibilities**

* Direct, supervise, and complete all on\-site operations whether those operations are completed by themselves, other FDC employees, such as; Assistant Managers, Leasing Agents, Maintenance persons, and/or outside vendors.
* Oversee on\-site operations including all aspects of property maintenance, vacancy preparation, rental activities, recordkeeping, resident relations, major projects and general administration.
* Apply knowledge of all FDC policies \& procedures, State \& Federal landlord and fair housing law, basic property maintenance, office machinery, and the computerized bookkeeping system.
* Cultivate and develop an effective on\-site team, overseeing day\-to\-day duties.

**Required Qualifications** *(Candidates who do not meet the minimum requirements will not be considered)*

* **Education \& Experience:** A 4\-year degree in a related field **OR** a minimum of 4 years of experience as a Community Manager.
* **Portfolio Scale:** Proven managerial experience running a property of at least 100\+ units.
* **Leadership:** Minimum of experience managing 2\+ direct reports.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* CRHP, CAM, ARM, CCRM certifications

**Physical Requirements**

All positions must be able to:

* Remain in a stationary position up to 50% of the time.
* Regularly move about inside the office to access file cabinets, office machinery, etc..
* Regularly tour and inspect apartment communities, grounds, and occasionally roof tops.
* Regularly operate a computer and other office productivity machinery, such as a calculator, copy machine, and computer printer.
* Regularly ascend/descend stairways.
* Occasionally ascend/descend ladders to access shelving or rooftops.
* Inspect the physical condition and cleanliness of apartment interiors and grounds.
* Occasionally lift, move or transport equipment or supplies weighing up to 25 pounds.
* Often works in outdoor weather conditions.
* Occasionally transport themselves to multiple varying locations as far as three hours distance.
* Occasionally travel overnight.
* Complete minor maintenance tasks.

FDC Management, Inc. offers a comprehensive benefits package to support our team, which includes:

* 401(k)
* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

jobs.description:
**Job Title: Project Coordinator / Program Coordinator – Hardware Test Systems \& NPI**

**Location\- Santa Clara, CA (Onsite)**

**Job type\- Full time**

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a Project Coordinator to support the development and deployment of complex hardware tester systems used in manufacturing and validation environments. The role will coordinate multiple PCBAs, mechanical assemblies, cables, connectors, and system\-level components through the full hardware lifecycle, including material readiness, build planning, system integration, bring\-up, validation, and production readiness. This position requires strong experience in PCBA\-based hardware programs, BOM and material management, cross\-functional coordination, and issue tracking across engineering, operations, suppliers, and manufacturing partners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate end\-to\-end execution of hardware tester system programs consisting of multiple PCBAs, mechanical parts, cables, connectors, power components, and system accessories.
* Track program milestones from concept, NPI, and prototype builds through validation and production readiness.
* Manage board\-level and system\-level BOM readiness, material availability, and part number tracking.
* Drive hardware build planning and execution across multiple boards and subsystems simultaneously.
* Partner with Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Validation, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Operations, and external suppliers to resolve issues and maintain schedules.
* Track engineering changes, material shortages, build risks, and dependency blockers.
* Monitor build status, integration readiness, bring\-up activities, validation progress, and issue closure.
* Maintain program dashboards, action item trackers, risk registers, and executive status reporting.
* Coordinate supplier and manufacturing partner activities to ensure material and build readiness.
* Facilitate regular cross\-functional meetings and drive accountability for deliverables and action items.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, or a related technical field.
* 3\+ years of experience in hardware program management, project coordination, NPI operations, or manufacturing operations.
* Experience supporting PCBA\-based products, server platforms, test systems, or hardware infrastructure programs.
* Strong understanding of BOM structures, hardware part numbering systems, material planning, and engineering change processes.
* Experience managing multiple board builds and system integration activities concurrently.
* Ability to interpret and track hardware assemblies, PCBAs, mechanical components, cables, and subsystem dependencies.
* Proficiency with project management tools, spreadsheets, and issue tracking systems.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting tester, fixture, validation, manufacturing, or datacenter hardware programs.
* Familiarity with hardware part numbering and BOM structures (e.g., board assemblies, system assemblies, manufacturing BOMs, and engineering BOMs).
* Experience working with contract manufacturers and hardware suppliers.
* Understanding of NPI, prototype, EVT/DVT/PVT, or manufacturing build processes.
* Experience coordinating material readiness, build execution, and validation activities in a fast\-paced hardware environment.

**Key Skills**

* Hardware NPI Program Management
* PCBA Program Coordination
* System Integration Readiness
* BOM \& Material Management
* Build Planning \& Execution
* Risk \& Issue Management
* Cross\-Functional Leadership
* Supplier \& Manufacturing Coordination
* Validation \& Bring\-Up Tracking
* Schedule \& Milestone Management

Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $124,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Relocation assistance
* Vision insurance

jobs.title: Program Coordinator - YAWL Work Based Learning
jobs.description:
**JOB ANNOUNCEMENT**


The Community Youth Center of San Francisco (CYC) provides the youth of our city a sense of belonging and vital tools and experiences to succeed in life. Our services include academic support and college counseling, job placement and employment training, substance use and violence prevention education, crisis intervention and mediation, leadership development, technology and computer training. Our mission is to encourage a diverse population of high\-need young people to explore their full potential through academic, career, family, and community life.

 **Title:****Program Coordinator \- YAWL Work Based Learning**

**Salary:****$30\.00 \- $34\.00 per hour plus excellent benefits**

**Reports to:****Program Supervisor**

**Status:****Full\-Time, (40 hours/week), Non\-Exempt**  

  

**Program Summary:** CYC’s YAWL Workforce Development Program provides job readiness and employment support services to youth ages 16\-24\. The program offers 1:1 job search and career coaching, work based learning internships, college and career exploration, and job shadowing opportunities to propel youth and young adults to be ready for college, work and reach productive adulthood.  

  

**Position Description:** Under the supervision of the Program Supervisor, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the Work Based Learning portfolio, supervising staff, overseeing workshops/trainings, establishing best practice program models, and providing high quality youth workforce and development services.

 **DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:**

* Oversee the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of the Young Adult Work Link program and comprehensive service delivery model.
* Develop policy and procedure recommendations to strengthen the program model and collaboration among grantee and coalition partners.
* Ensure program development and service delivery align with “Youth Program Quality Standards” and meet all “Work Plan” deliverables and deadlines.
* Complete all required documentation, reports, and program deliverables in a timely manner.
* Lead citywide outreach and recruitment efforts, cultivating strategic community partnerships and developing a robust referral network to support recruitment and engagement, with a focus on priority populations.
* Develop and facilitate job readiness training workshops, including but not limited to professionalism, career exploration, resume and cover letter building, job search/navigation, interview skill development, mock interviews, and strength/talent identification.
* Coordinate subsidized internships, recruiting local SF businesses/employers to partner as a worksite and provide support to worksite supervisors and participants throughout the internship period.
* Conduct participant assessments and provide intensive case management, wraparound supportive services, and guidance to address barriers affecting work and school performance.
* Develop individualized vocational goals and career plans using vocational and interest assessments, and provide personal and career guidance.
* Coordinate GED attainment, tutoring, basic skills remediation, postsecondary education, and workforce training services.
* Provide 1:1 career guidance and assist participants with individualized education and career planning services, job search and placement assistance and conduct follow ups for retention services.
* Connect participants to resources within CYC and other CBO or city services for barrier removal to ensure their success.
* Supervise, support, coach and train Program Specialists in job readiness training content, career counseling, outreach, funder databases, and other duties as applicable.
* Collaborate with the workforce team to strategize on program planning, development and implementation of overall youth workforce development programs and outcomes.
* Partnerships/Event Planning
* Coordinate career exploration events and adult mentoring opportunities such as worksite/company tours, college tours, and networking events for program participants
* Support agency\-wide events and perform other duties as assigned by management.

 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* Bachelor's degree in relevant field.
* Experience working with diverse youth backgrounds, preferably within youth workforce development programs.
* Previous experience in program coordination, internship coordination, and development
* Ability to work with ethnically diverse groups of low\-income youth as well as English learners to support their social and emotional needs during transition.
* At least 1 year of experience supervising a team of three or more staff.
* Experience working with San Francisco's diverse communities and neighborhoods.
* Experience working with community\-based service providers and private sector partners.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills and proficiency in Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Zoom, and other technology platforms.
* Experience facilitating workshops for youth and young adults.
* Ability to work as part of a team, to prioritize and handle multiple tasks and to work independently in a high\-pressure environment.
* Bilingual in Cantonese/Mandarin/Spanish and English is preferred.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills.
* Enthusiasm for promoting academic achievement and college education.
* Able to lift or move at least 25lbs
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends.

* Class \& On\-Site Supervision: Visit partner schools within designated hours to oversee program execution, introduce yourself to school staff and instructors, and support live classroom operations.
* Instructional Coordination: Manage the end\-to\-end creation, tracking, and review of lesson plans to maintain program quality and educational standards.
* Schedule \& Agenda Management: Attend weekly alignment meetings with the Operations Coordinator to review priorities and independently build your site visitation schedule.

jobs.description:
Golden State Dermatology is a physician\-led and owned dermatology group rapidly expanding across California. We are a leading medical, surgical, and cosmetic dermatology group specializing in skin, hair, and nail conditions, Mohs micrographic surgery for the treatment of skin cancer, surgical and non\-surgical cosmetic skincare, anti\-aging, body contouring, and plastic surgery.

  

The Clinical Research Coordinator supports the conduct of clinical trials under the direction of the Principal Investigator and research leadership. This position is responsible for coordinating assigned studies and ensuring study activities are completed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with study protocols, ICH\-GCP guidelines, FDA regulations, and institutional requirements.

  

The Coordinator works closely with study participants, investigators, sponsors, CROs, monitors, and other research staff. Responsibilities include study start\-up and regulatory activities, participant recruitment and study visits, source documentation and EDC entry, safety reporting, study supply management, monitoring visit preparation, and study close\-out.

  

This position requires strong organization, attention to detail, communication, and problem\-solving skills, as well as the ability to manage multiple priorities and proactively identify and escalate study\-related issues. Frequent travel to the Walnut Creek study site is required.

 **Essential Responsibilities**

* Prepare and maintain regulatory documents, including IRB submissions, amendments, and continuing reviews.
* Maintain regulatory binders and essential study documents.
* Complete study\-specific training and maintain required training documentation.
* Assist with preparation for site initiation visits, monitoring visits, sponsor visits, audits, and inspections.
* Perform study activities in accordance with ICH\-GCP, FDA regulations, study protocols, and applicable institutional requirements.

* Receive, organize, and maintain study supplies, devices, and equipment.
* Process and ship laboratory specimens and other study materials according to protocol requirements.

 **Subject Management**

* Support participant recruitment, prescreening, screening, enrollment, and retention.
* Obtain and document informed consent when appropriately delegated by the Principal Investigator.
* Coordinate participant visits and study\-related procedures.
* Maintain communication with participants regarding study visits and requirements.
* Protect participant rights, safety, privacy, and confidentiality.
* Document protocol deviations and assist with required follow\-up and corrective actions.
* Escort participants to local approved study sites (phlebotomy and radiology) when required.

 **Data \& Documentation**

* Complete accurate and timely source documentation.
* Enter study data into electronic data capture (EDC) systems within required timelines.
* Review study data and documentation for accuracy and completeness.
* Respond to and resolve data queries promptly.
* Maintain organized study files and documentation suitable for sponsor monitoring and regulatory review.
* Ensure study documentation supports protocol and regulatory requirements.

 **Safety \& Quality**

* Identify and document adverse events and serious adverse events and promptly escalate them to the Principal Investigator.
* Complete required safety reporting to sponsors and IRBs according to applicable procedures and timelines.
* Review assigned study work for completeness, accuracy, and protocol compliance.
* Identify documentation or process discrepancies and assist with their resolution.
* Participate in corrective and preventive actions when applicable.

 **Monitoring \& Sponsor Coordination**

* Prepare study records and materials for monitoring visits.
* Participate in sponsor and CRO monitoring visits.
* Respond to monitor requests and follow up on action items within required timelines.
* Maintain clear and professional communication with sponsors, CROs, monitors, and study personnel.
* Escalate unresolved sponsor, operational, or regulatory issues to research leadership or the Principal Investigator.

 **Financial \& Administrative Support**

* Maintain accurate records of participant visits, study activities, and participant stipends.
* Prepare and submit invoices to sponsors/CROs for billable study activities in accordance with study budgets and contracts.
* Track sponsor payments and assist with payment reconciliation, including identifying and following up on outstanding or discrepant payments.
* Maintain documentation necessary to support study billing and financial reconciliation.

* Assist with study close\-out activities.
* Resolve outstanding documentation and data items before study closure.
* Ensure study records are complete and organized for appropriate archiving.

jobs.title: Account Manager 2, Merchant Services Managed Money Accounts
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------


As a Merchant Services Account Manager, you play a vital role in driving growth and protecting revenue for our mid\-market customers. Your primary objective is to deeply engage with customers, gaining a thorough understanding of their business needs across all locations. Leveraging your expertise, you'll demonstrate our core capabilities and recommend the right merchant processing solution stack to meet their specific requirements. Collaborating with internal support partners and resources, you'll ensure seamless execution of our solutions, contributing to Intuit's mission of disrupting the small business mid\-market segment.

 **Responsibilities**

* Exemplify Intuit's values and foster an inclusive environment conducive to collaboration and innovation.
* Proactively identify opportunities to drive business improvements for existing customers, providing strategic recommendations aligned with their needs.
* Articulate Intuit's value propositions within the merchant services domain, showcasing understanding of our strategies and products relative to competitors.
* Deliver compelling presentations to C\-level executives, effectively communicating ROI and value propositions.
* Grow and manage a robust sales funnel, maintaining a sustainable sales cycle to meet quarterly targets.
* Collaborate with key stakeholders to influence the buying process and navigate complex selling processes.
* Serve as a cross\-functional facilitator, leveraging resources to support business relationship growth and execution.
* Utilize all available resources to efficiently close deals and drive scalability.
* Measure success through key metrics including quota attainment, close rates, pipeline velocity, and retention improvements.

 **Qualifications**

* Minimum 5\+ years of quota\-carrying software or technology sales and corporate account management experience.
* Extensive experience in territory management across multiple states and industries, preferably within the merchant services domain.
* Deep understanding of Account Receivable and Account Payable processes related to money movement.
* Familiarity with merchant services customers owning multiple locations and annual revenues exceeding $5M.
* Familiarity with merchant service industry standards as it relates to rates, cost analysis, and risk management.
* Experience selling merchant services platform solutions with negotiated rates/terms across various industries.
* Strong business acumen and sales skills, with the ability to innovate and iterate.
* Prior experience with accounting, ERP, or financial management software sales.
* Proficiency in managing a large prospect pipeline through Salesforce and supporting multiple partners through the sales process.
* Familiarity with key sales methodologies such as Challenger, SPIN, Solution, or Sandler.
* Understanding of the client management lifecycle and ability to collaborate effectively with diverse stakeholders.
* Bachelor's degree or MBA preferred or equivalent work experience.

  

Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers \| Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job\-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.


The expected base pay range for this position is:
  

Mountain View, CA $100,000\- $135,000

 **Summary:**  

The Outside Sales Representative is responsible for the sales and marketing efforts with the objective of increased profitable sales through creating, building, and maintaining high quality relationships with new and existing customers. Utilize company digital tools and company products and services to connect with consumers, develop creative solutions, generate sales volume, and provide the highest level of customer service.  

  

**What You'll Do:**

* Responsible for selling, marketing, promoting, and demonstrating products. Effectively communicate the features and benefits of our product offering
* Increase business by generating sales to new customers and by selling additional products to existing customers
* Collaborate with leadership, team members, and suppliers in planning, tracking, and implementing sales strategies and developing new markets

jobs.description:
**About Anthropic**
-------------------



Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

**About the role**
------------------



Join Anthropic as a Customer Success Manager supporting our Beneficial Deployments team's initiatives in Life Sciences. As a Customer Success Manager for Life Sciences, you’ll be a strategic partner and trusted advisor to the world's leading organizations working to accelerate scientific discovery. You will help them harness the full potential of Claude's capabilities across the API, Claude for Enterprise, Claude Code, and Claude Science to accelerate their scientific work.



This is a hybrid role that blends deep 1:1 account management with scaled, one\-to\-many programs. You'll own a portfolio of named strategic accounts, such as research institutes, academic medical centers, scientific foundations, and mission\-driven biotech, where you'll build genuine partnerships grounded in a deep understanding of their research mission, scientific objectives, programmatic goals, and technical capacity. You will help these organizations scale their usage effectively drive model and use case optimization, implement change management strategies, and maximize the value of their investment through expanded use cases across their organization. Alongside that portfolio, you'll design and run a handful of one\-to\-many engagement programs, including webinars, hackathons, cohort\-based enablement, and researcher communities, that extend Claude's impact across the broader life sciences ecosystem well beyond any single partner relationship.

* 6\+ years of experience in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Solutions Engineering

* Deep understanding of regulations, risk, and compliance needs of the industry
* Experience driving success across both consumption\-based and seat\-based business models, with understanding of different expansion levers and success metrics for each
* Experience designing and delivering one\-to\-many customer programs (webinars, hackathons, cohort\-based onboarding, user communities, or similar) alongside managing dedicated strategic accounts
