jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Hub \- San Francisco


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Hybrid


**Department**
--------------


G\&AStrategy and Operations


**Compensation**
----------------


$186K – $255K


  
*Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.*


*Superhuman team members in this role must be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and they must be able to collaborate in person 2 days a week.*  



**About Superhuman**
--------------------


Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs's collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. Learn more at superhuman.com and about our values here.


**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We are looking for a Business Operations Lead to partner with the leadership team of one of Superhuman’s Business Units (BUs) to drive strategic clarity, operational alignment, and execution across the BU’s most important initiatives. Our BUs are led by an Engineering, Product, Design, and Marketing (EPDM) leadership team — with the Product leader as the point of the spear — and this role exists to make that BU and its leadership team successful as we expand our product portfolio in a compound\-startup model.


This role sits at the intersection of strategy, operations, and cross\-functional execution. You will solid\-line into the Strategy \& Operations organization and dotted\-line into your Business Unit, giving you both a durable operating craft and deep proximity to the leaders you serve. You’ll turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans as a long\-term operational partner to the BU rather than a project\-based resource. Your partners will span the company, from other BUs to our Route\-to\-Market (RTM) teams and functional experts. It is truly an opportunity to have an outsized impact!


In this role you will:


* Partner with your BU’s EPDM leadership team — anchored by the Product leader as the point of the spear — to turn strategy into clear priorities, decisions, and execution plans.
* Planning \& Performance: run team\-level planning, goal\-setting, business reviews, and performance tracking connected to company\-wide planning cycles, so leaders can focus on decision\-making.
* Special Projects: take dedicated ownership of the BU’s most complex, cross\-functional initiatives so key efforts have a clear owner and don’t stall.
* Ways of Working: build the rhythms, cadences, documentation, and tooling so the team isn’t rebuilding its operating infrastructure from scratch each quarter or with each reorg.
* Leadership Extension: represent your leaders in forums, cross\-company meetings, and escalation paths as a trusted delegate — not just a coordinator — so key decisions don’t wait on calendar openings.
* Partners across the company with other BUs, Route\-to\-Market (RTM) teams and functional experts to have an outsized impact on the trajectory of our organization.
* Facilitate strong information flow up, across, and down the organization to enable fast, informed decision\-making in a matrixed, multi\-product environment.
* Drive operational readiness for new products, integrations, and cross\-functional launches by coordinating planning and enablement across the BU and its RTM partners.
* Independently drive initiatives day to day while scoping and partnering with the broader Strategy \& Operations team for support on key motions.

Example Impact (First 6–12 Months):


* Establish a clear operating cadence, planning rhythms, business review, and governance model, dashboards, etc. for the BU to drive visibility, accountability, and faster decisions.
* Take ownership of one or more of the BU’s most complex initiatives — for example a cross\-functional launch or the integration of an acquired product or team — and see it through.
* Define and track success metrics for the BU, linking operational outcomes to company goals.

**Qualifications**
------------------

Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship.

Wage ranges are based on various factors, including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.


All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program. Bonus eligibility is reviewed at the time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.  



  

Why Join Us:


We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well\-being.


Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 890,000\+ customers around the globe.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator - San Francisco
jobs.description:
At HOKALI, we simplify how schools book, organize, and manage after\-school programs and camps. Our platform helps schools find and book a wide variety of onsite programs to supplement learning and enrich students' extracurricular experiences. We believe every child deserves the opportunity to explore their interests and reach their full potential.


About the Role
We are looking for a detail\-oriented **Logistics Coordinator (Part\-Time)** to oversee our inventory, material distribution, and site supply operations. In this role, you will manage gear, uniforms, and educational supplies from receipt to final site delivery across the SF Bay Area.


You will be responsible for receiving shipments, maintaining an organized storage facility, building program packages, and ensuring all materials reach our partner school sites efficiently.


Key Responsibilities* Inventory \& Storage Management: Receive, inspect, organize, and properly label all incoming inventory, program materials, and staff uniforms at our central storage facility.
* Stock Tracking \& Records: Maintain accurate, up\-to\-date inventory records and log all incoming/outgoing items.
* Kitting \& Package Assembly: Assemble, pack, and prepare welcome kits, uniforms, and site\-specific material packages according to program needs.
* Distribution \& Shipping: Coordinate shipments via carriers (UPS/FedEx) or personally deliver supplies directly to partner school sites as needed.
* Regional Logistics Coverage: Manage supply operations across the SF Bay Area / Oakland, with scheduled site/storage visits to San Jose approximately once per month.
* Internal Communication: Coordinate closely with operations teams via Slack and track hours using TriNet.


Schedule \& Compensation* Type: Part\-Time (Flexibility based on weekly operational volume).
* Schedule: Estimated 4–8 hours per week (flexible scheduling).
* Compensation: $28 – $32 / hour \+ Mileage Reimbursement for personal vehicle usage (or $35 / hour flat rate inclusive of travel).
* Locations: SF Bay Area / Oakland (with monthly travel to San Jose).

 **Requirements**  

* Reliable Personal Vehicle (Required): Must have a valid driver’s license, active auto insurance, and a clean driving record to transport and deliver materials/boxes between sites.
* Physical Capability: Ability to lift, carry, and move boxes and equipment weighing up to 40 lbs.
* Prior experience in warehouse management, inventory control, or field logistics preferred.
* Excellent organizational skills and high attention to detail.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and maintain organized records.
* Proficiency with digital tools (Slack, spreadsheets, shipping platforms).

  

**Benefits**  

* Competitive compensation.
* Flexible scheduling aligned with your availability and operational needs.
* Access to the HOKALI Academy—a community space designed for educators to learn, connect, and collaborate.
* Structured lesson plans provided, with room to bring your own creative ideas to class.
* Opportunities for professional growth and expanded responsibilities within HOKALI.
* Employee Referral Program with bonus incentives.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
**About Generalist**
====================


At Generalist, we are on a mission to build general intelligence for the physical world and make it useful to everyone. We believe the industries and homes of the future will depend on humans and machines working together in new ways. Robots can help us build more and get more done.


We build embodied foundation models, starting with a focus on dexterity. This requires advancing the frontiers of data, models, and hardware, to enable robots to intelligently interact with the physical world.


The company embraces both large\-scale AI and robotics as core to its DNA. Our team of researchers, roboticists, and company builders come from OpenAI, Boston Dynamics, Google DeepMind, and other frontier labs—with a track record of shipping AI breakthroughs. Before Generalist, we pioneered large embodied multimodal models and vision\-language\-action models (PaLM\-E, RT\-2, Gemini Robotics), launched and scaled ChatGPT and GPT\-4 to hundreds of millions of users, engineered the foundations of autonomous driving, built next\-generation robots (Atlas, Spot, Stretch) and pushed the limits of what they can do (from parkour to manipulation, and testing robustness).


We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

### **About the Role**


At Generalist, we build foundation models for the physical world. Across our team in San Mateo and Boston, we know that our company’s future is shaped entirely by the people who join us. That’s why we care deeply about making every candidate feel welcomed, valued, and respected from their very first conversation to their very first day on the job.


As our Recruiting Coordinator, you’ll be the heart of that candidate experience!


You will serve as our operational anchor, bringing warmth, organization, and clarity to interview scheduling, candidate communication, and overall hiring logistics. Sitting at the intersection of every team at Generalist, you'll play a vital role in building our culture and company.


You will be in the San Mateo office five days a week.

**Here’s what you’ll be doing:**

* Lead the scheduling of all interview stages — from initial chats and screens to full on\-sites — across San Mateo, Boston, and candidate time zones using Ashby.
* Be the main guide and friendly contact for candidates throughout their journey, ensuring every touchpoint feels thoughtful, well\-organized, and seamless.
* Coordinate travel and expenses for visiting candidates, ensuring flights, hotel stays, ground transit, and reimbursements are effortless for them.
* Keep Ashby running smoothly and reliably — maintaining stage accuracy, interview plans, email templates, direct\-booking links, and interviewer training records.
* Support interviewer balance across our team by distributing schedules fairly and flagging early when we need to expand our interviewer pool.
* Keep pipelines flowing effortlessly by spotting potential bottlenecks, resolving delays, and troubleshooting scheduling conflicts proactively.
* Partner on offer logistics — from background checks and Ashby offer packets to sending personalized welcome notes and swag — ensuring a delightful handoff to HR and IT for day one.
* Treat candidate privacy with utmost care and discretion at every step of the process.
* Continuously refine our recruiting tools, templates, and workflows to make our interview operations increasingly efficient and candidate\-friendly.

**You might thrive in this role if you:**

* Have 1\+ year(s) coordinating interviews at volume, or comparable experience — an EA supporting several executives, or an operations role where you owned complex multi\-party scheduling and the consequences of getting it wrong.
* Have worked in Ashby and know its scheduling, interview plans, templates, and interviewer pools well enough to have opinions about how they should be set up.
* Write unusually well in short forms. A reschedule email from you makes a candidate feel taken care of rather than processed, and a note to a hiring manager tells them exactly what you need in three lines.
* Are precise by disposition. Names spelled correctly, links tested before they are sent, time zones right the first time, and no interview that starts with five minutes of confusion.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and adjust quickly when schedules shift, candidates re\-route, or hiring needs change.
* Genuine customer service orientation – you treat every candidate, hiring manager, and interviewer like the most important person in your inbox.
* Interest in a long\-term career in People, Talent, or HR – with curiosity about how recruiting operations scale as a company grows.
* Are energized by being in the office five days a week and want to be in the room on the days that matter.

jobs.title: Clinical Research Coordinator - Pediatrics Research
jobs.description:
The Clinical Research Coordinator (CRC) will perform independently or with general direction at the fully operational journey level of the series to execute, manage, and coordinate research protocols, as directed by the Clinical Research Supervisor and/or Principal Investigator (PI) in the Department of Pediatrics; may coordinate the data collection and operations of several concurrent clinical research studies under the guidelines of research protocols, UCSF and regulating agency policies.  



The CRC’s duties may include, but will not be limited to supporting the management and coordinating the tasks of single or multiple clinical research studies, depending on their size and complexity; act as intermediary between services and departments while overseeing data and specimen management; manage and report on study results; create, clean, update, and manage databases and comprehensive datasets and reports; coordinate staff work schedules and assist Clinical Research Supervisor and/or PI with oversight of other research staff; manage Investigator’s protocols in the Institutional Review Board (IRB) online system, as well as renewals and modifications of protocol applications and the implementation of new studies; participate in the review and writing of protocols to ensure institutional review board approval within University compliance; help assure compliance with all relevant regulatory agencies; oversee study data integrity; implement and maintain periodic quality control procedures; interface with departments to obtain UCSF approval prior to study initiation; maintain all regulatory documents; report study progress to investigators; participate in any internal and external audits or reviews of study protocols.
  
Required Qualifications:


* High School Diploma; or equivalent experience
* Attention to detail; strong interpersonal skills; excellent, effective verbal and written communication skills to coordinate with subjects, team members, other departments and outside institutions; and the ability to multi\-task in a fast\-paced environment while working with a diverse subject population
Ability to work well independently, complete projects in a timely manner, and prioritize multiple projects to ensure the completion of essential tasks by deadlines  
* 

Preferred Qualifications:


* Fluent in Spanish
* BA/BS degree with biology coursework included
* Two years experience in a clinical research setting
* Fluency in the usage of Committee of Human Research (CHR) online iMEDris system for submission, renewal, and modification of protocols through this system
* Understanding of patient population to create rapport and a relationship, while also giving insight to what is realistic and appropriate for patient participation
* Experience with electronic medical records
* Knowledge of medical terminology, and/or the ability to apply information to the assessment, interpretation, and processing of medical data
* Experience applying the following regulations and guidelines:
	+ Good Clinical Practice Guidelines
	+ Health Information and Accountability Act (HIPAA)
	+ The Protection of Human Research Subjects
	+ CHR regulations for recruitment and consent of research subjects
	+ Effective Cash Handling Procedures
	+ Environmental Health and Safety Training
	+ Fire Safety Training

jobs.description:

------------


Hub \- San Francisco


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**

Hybrid


**Department**
--------------


G\&AStrategy and Operations


**Compensation**
----------------


$152K – $163K • Offers Equity


  
*Superhuman offers a dynamic hybrid working model for this role. This flexible approach gives team members the best of both worlds: plenty of focus time along with in\-person collaboration that helps foster trust, innovation, and a strong team culture.*


*Superhuman team members in this role must be based in the San Francisco Bay Area, and they must be able to collaborate in person 3 days per week.*

  

**About Superhuman**
--------------------


Grammarly is now part of Superhuman, the AI productivity platform on a mission to unlock the superhuman potential in everyone. The Superhuman suite of apps and agents brings AI wherever people work, integrating with over 1 million applications and websites. The company’s products include Grammarly’s writing assistance, Superhuman Docs’s collaborative workspaces, Mail’s inbox management, and Go, the proactive AI assistant that understands context and delivers help automatically. Founded in 2009, Superhuman empowers over 40 million people, 50,000 organizations, and 3,000 educational institutions worldwide to eliminate busywork and focus on what matters. *Learn more at**superhuman.com* *and about our* *values here**.*

  

**The Opportunity**
-------------------


We’re looking for an **Executive Assistant** to support senior leaders in our People Org across the company and help move some of our most cross\-functional, high\-impact initiatives forward. This role is based in our San Francisco hub and requires in\-office presence 3 times per week.


As an Executive Assistant, you’ll be a strategic and operational partner — not just managing logistics, but helping leaders stay focused, prepared, and connected to what matters most. You’ll work at the intersection of company\-wide priorities and functional execution, gaining exposure to executive\-level strategy and decision\-making.


As an Executive Assistant, you will:


* Manage complex calendars, coordinate travel logistics, organize inboxes, submit expenses, and ensure seamless day\-to\-day execution.
* Prepare materials for key meetings — including talking points, briefing documents, and polished decks — to help leaders engage with insight and confidence.
* Track and manage cross\-functional action items to ensure follow\-ups are completed and initiatives stay on track.
* Manage communication between leaders and other internal or external stakeholders, liaising with executives, partners, and team members across the company.
* Plan and orchestrate work to ensure leaders’ priorities are met, organizational goals are achieved, and best practices are upheld.
* Handle sensitive information with a high degree of professionalism, discretion, and emotional intelligence, maintaining trust and integrity at all times.

**Qualifications**
------------------


We are looking for a highly capable and forward\-thinking Executive Assistant who thrives in fast\-paced, ever\-evolving environments. The ideal candidate brings a unique combination of operational excellence, strategic acumen, and emotional intelligence to support the leader in achieving maximum impact.


Success in this role will come naturally if you:


* Has 5\+ years of professional experience, and 3\+ years of experience supporting senior leaders, ideally in fast\-paced, high\-growth, or startup environments.
* Think in systems and enjoy simplifying complexity — with the ability to build intuitive, effective tools (like a well\-crafted Superhuman Doc) that drive clarity and alignment.
* Experience drafting and sending communications on behalf of executives, with a strong ability to operate effectively in asynchronous environments.
* Act as a true force multiplier for executives — anticipating needs, managing details, and creating leverage in every interaction.
* Remain calm, resourceful, and solution\-oriented in the face of ambiguity or rapid change, always bringing a steady, thoughtful approach to problem\-solving.
* Communicate with clarity and empathy, both in writing and in person, helping to refine and elevate the leader's voice in internal documents and presentations.
* Care deeply about people and team culture, and are energized by helping high\-performing teams stay connected, aligned, and effective.
* Has a demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal guidance, proactively manages tasks and priorities across multiple projects, analyzes and executes work efficiently, collaborates effectively with cross\-functional teams, and thrives in fast\-paced, results\-driven environments.

**Compensation and Benefits**
-----------------------------


Superhuman offers all team members competitive pay along with a benefits package encompassing the following and more:


* Excellent health care (including a wide range of medical, dental, vision, mental health, and fertility benefits)
* Disability and life insurance options
* 401(k) and RRSP matching

OpenGov is the leader in AI and ERP solutions for local and state governments in the U.S. More than 2,000 cities, counties, state agencies, school districts, and special districts rely on the OpenGov Public Service Platform to operate efficiently, adapt to change, and strengthen the public trust. Category\-leading products include enterprise asset management, procurement and contract management, accounting and budgeting, billing and revenue management, permitting and licensing, and transparency and open data. These solutions come together in the OpenGov ERP, allowing public sector organizations to focus on priorities and deliver maximum ROI with every dollar and decision in sync. Learn about OpenGov’s mission to power more effective and accountable government and the vision of high\-performance government for every community at OpenGov.com.

**Job Summary**
---------------


We are seeking an exceptional Executive Assistant to provide strategic and operational support to the Chief Administrative Officer, Chief Financial Officer, and General Counsel. This role is central to driving operational excellence, fostering company culture, and enabling strategic decision\-making across OpenGov's executive leadership team.


The ideal candidate will be a proactive, culturally\-attuned partner who excels at managing complex executive priorities while serving as a cultural bridge across the organization. You'll coordinate high\-impact events, offsites, and initiatives that strengthen OpenGov's culture and engagement, while simultaneously managing the sophisticated logistics of supporting three senior executives in a fast\-paced, mission\-driven environment.


This is a unique opportunity for someone who wants to amplify impact beyond traditional admin work. You'll be instrumental in shaping how leadership connects with the organization, how key decisions get made, and how our people experience OpenGov's values.

**Core Responsibilities**
-------------------------


Executive Support \& Strategic Partnership

* Multi\-Executive Calendar \& Inbox Management: Proactively manage complex calendars for the CAO, CFO, and GC across multiple time zones and business priorities. Anticipate scheduling conflicts, suggest trade\-offs, and block time strategically to protect focus on highest\-impact work.
* Executive Coordination \& Alignment: Serve as a key connective node between the three executives and across organizational departments. Facilitate seamless communication, flag misalignments early, and help drive execution on shared priorities.
* Meeting Preparation \& Documentation: Develop comprehensive briefing materials, agendas and presentations for team meetings. Take detailed notes during key discussions, clearly document action items with owners and deadlines, and ensure follow\-through on commitments.
* Travel Management: Plan domestic and international travel itineraries for executives and leadership team. Handle logistics including accommodations, ground transportation, visa coordination, and real\-time adjustments. Leverage AI tools to optimize travel planning and expense reporting.
* Process Optimization \& Documentation: Identify opportunities to streamline recurring processes (meeting cadences, approvals, communications). Document processes and maintain operational playbooks that scale as the company grows.


Culture \& Events Leadership


Culture Events \& Execution: Help support company all hands meetings, happy hours and other internal events, working cross functionally with partners in Workplace and HR.

* Offsite Management: Lead the planning and execution of team offsites. This may include venue selection, agenda design and logistics coordination. Create experiences that foster strategic thinking, team building, and culture reinforcement.
* Cultural Listening \& Insight: Maintain a pulse on team engagement and culture through informal connections across the organization. Bring observations and insights to leadership about what's resonating, what needs attention, and how to strengthen culture.


AI \& Modern Tools Leadership

* AI Tool Adoption and Workflow Innovation: Actively explore and pilot AI\-powered tools to enhance team productivity. Examples: scheduling automation, meeting transcription and summarization, email drafting assistance, presentation generation, and workflow optimization.
* Best Practices Sharing: Stay informed on emerging AI and automation trends and share insights with the broader admin team.

  

**Key Attributes \& Competencies**
----------------------------------


Strategic Mindset

* Understands the business context behind decisions and initiatives
* Anticipates needs before they're asked for
* Thinks beyond the immediate task to broader impact


Cultural Intelligence \& EQ

* High emotional intelligence with ability to build trust and read the room across all levels of the organization
* Balances professionalism with warmth; demonstrates OpenGov values in daily interactions


Operational Excellence

* Obsessive attention to detail while managing high complexity
* Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities
* Strong time management and ability to juggle competing priorities


Communication \& Influence

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to distill complex information into clear executive summaries
* Comfortable communicating with executives, boards, and employees


Judgment \& Discretion

* Trustworthy with confidential and sensitive information
* Demonstrates good judgment about what needs escalation vs. what you can handle independently
* Maintains objectivity and professionalism in complex situations


Learning Agility \& Curiosity

* Quick learner who becomes fluent in OpenGov's business, products, and culture
* Intellectually curious about how organizations work and how to make them work better
* Comfortable with technology and eager to learn new tools

NYCHA has implemented a Zone Model approach, which leverages NYCHA’s and partner resources to expand economic opportunity for public housing residents through place\-based service coordination. Through this new approach, REES enables NYCHA to (1\) Generate more economic opportunities for NYCHA residents and NYCHA neighborhoods, while strategically investing and leveraging NYCHA’s spend; (2\) Provide a more comprehensive economic empowerment platform with additional capacities around financial literacy, asset building and business development; (3\) Reduce the duplication of services – better investing limited resources; (4\) Enable NYCHA to be a better partner to community\-based organizations, government agencies, philanthropies, community colleges, schools, employers and other key stakeholders; and (5\) Drive more resources and investment into public housing neighborhoods.
  

  

REES seeks a dynamic Project Coordinator, Financial Capability to join the Financial Capability and Resident Business Development unit, which develops strategies, programs and initiatives geared towards increasing economic outcomes for NYCHA residents in the areas of financial literacy/counseling and asset building to achieve the following goals: starting or increasing savings; accessing mainstream financial services; establishing and/or improving credit; reducing debt and increasing free tax preparation usage.

8\. Represent REES at occasional evening meetings with internal and external stakeholders.

2\. NYCHA residents are encouraged to apply.
  

3\. NYCHA provides benefits that include a choice of medical coverage plans, deferred compensation plans and a defined pension benefit plan as a member of the New York City Employees’ Retirement System (NYCERS).

Role based in: New York, NY


Reports to: Digital Marketing \& Content Manager

  

maman is a french bakery, café and leading lifestyle brand founded in 2014 by owners elisa marshall \& benjamin sormonte, with locations across north america and canada. inspired by family traditions, and the highest quality ingredients, maman offers a selection of delicious baked goods {including their famous nutty chocolate chip cookie}, coffee, fresh breakfast, and lunch options spanning from hearty salads \& sandwiches to savory quiches. in addition to hosting intimate events, maman has partnered with leading brands for partnerships and activations. from baby showers and birthday parties to engagements, they're able to help celebrate customers \& make new beautiful memories.

They are passionate about social media, hospitality, food, and digital culture, with a strong visual eye and an instinct for turning campaign priorities into social\-first content people want to watch, share, save, and talk about.


Reporting to the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager, this person will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social media channels, with a primary focus on content creation, copywriting, publishing, and community engagement. They will bring broader campaign strategy and messaging to life through Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, captions, and recurring content series, while helping shape maman’s social voice in a way that remains warm, playful, and unmistakably on\-brand. What you'll do:


SOCIAL MEDIA \& CONTENT CREATION

* Handle daily community engagement across comments, DMs, tags, mentions, and guest questions.

* Proofread guest\-facing content for tone, grammar, spelling, links, dates, pricing, location details, and overall accuracy.

  

DIGITAL MARKETING SUPPORT

* Support digital campaigns across social, email, website, app, partnerships, and other digital channels.
* Assist with seasonal launches, partnerships, photoshoots, promotions, events, new\-store openings, and broader brand initiatives.
* Help with email copy, ad copy, website copy, campaign recaps, research, and special projects as needed.

  

What we’re looking for:

* 2–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, or a related field.

* A visual eye and understanding of what makes content feel engaging, polished, and on\-brand.

* Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple drafts, deadlines, and priorities.
* Kind, passionate, curious, collaborative, detail\-oriented, highly accountable, and always willing to lend a hand.

* Support to help you settle into the role and learning opportunities to broaden your skill set.
* The opportunity to work across social media, content, hospitality, events, partnerships, and community\-building.
* Generous employee discount.
* A collaborative and creative team environment where new ideas are encouraged!
* Great opportunity to progress with maman, with internal mobility and growth encouraged when possible.


Keep in mind that maman is growing and developing every day. We all do a little bit of everything and like to roll up our sleeves to help a colleague out!


We are looking for awesome, hard\-working people that are all about creating the most memorable experience for every single maman customer.  

  

Thank you for your interest in maman and look forward to speaking with you!

**Manufacturer’s Sales Representative**

**Outside Sales Representative – New Territory Development**

Stonehenge US

Stonehenge US is looking for a motivated Outside Sales Representative to help develop new business and expand our dealer network throughout Pennsylvania, Delaware, and surrounding markets.

This is a true business\-development position. We already have established sales territories throughout New Jersey and New York, and this position will focus primarily on identifying, scouting, opening, and developing new dealer accounts in markets where we are looking to grow.

Our products include natural stone veneer, manufactured stone, thin brick, bluestone, limestone and step treads, porcelain pavers, artificial grass, outdoor living products, solar paver lights, iron doors, and other building and hardscape products.

**Compensation \& Schedule**

* $70,000 base salary
* Commission of approximately $12,000 for every $1 million in sales
* Monday through Friday
* Approximately 45 hours per week
* Full\-time position
* Primarily field\-based outside sales

This is a developing territory, so we understand that it will take time to build relationships, open dealers, and grow the sales volume. The base salary provides stability while the territory is being developed, with additional earning potential as sales grow.

**Company\-Provided Vehicle \& Equipment**

Stonehenge US provides the tools needed to operate effectively in the field, including:

* Company Ford F\-150
* Company gas card
* Company E\-ZPass
* Company cell phone
* Company iPad
* Product samples, catalogs, promotional materials, and other sales tools
* Company\-paid normal business travel expenses

**Territory \& Location**

Stonehenge US’s main warehouse and office is located in Staten Island, New York, but this position will spend the majority of its time in the field developing new business throughout Pennsylvania, Delaware, and surrounding markets.

Because of the territory, a candidate located in or near our Staten island warehouse or South Jersey particularly areas such as Cherry Hill, Marlton, Voorhees, Maple Shade, Mount Laurel, or surrounding areas would be well positioned for this role, with convenient access to Philadelphia, southeastern Pennsylvania, Delaware, and New Jersey.

The salesperson will also need to travel to our Staten Island location periodically for meetings, training, samples, promotional materials, and other sales needs.

The position is not limited to South Jersey candidates. We are primarily looking for the right person who is comfortable traveling throughout the territory and actively developing new markets.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Researching and identifying new masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, building material, lumber, and related dealers
* Scouting new markets throughout Pennsylvania and Delaware
* Cold calling and scheduling meetings with owners, purchasers, managers, and other decision\-makers
* Visiting prospective dealers and learning their existing product mix and suppliers
* Identifying where Stonehenge US products can solve a problem or fill a gap
* Developing relationships from the first introduction through the first order and beyond
* Presenting products, pricing, displays, samples, and dealer programs
* Creating and managing sales opportunities and follow\-up
* Developing new accounts into consistent long\-term customers
* Planning efficient daily routes and managing your territory independently
* Working with our Sales Manager and internal team when assistance is needed on larger opportunities

**What We’re Looking For**

We are looking for someone who is comfortable building a territory rather than simply maintaining an existing customer list.

The right person should be:

* Self\-motivated
* Organized
* Persistent
* Comfortable cold calling and walking into new businesses
* Able to research and qualify prospects independently
* Comfortable speaking with owners, purchasers, and decision\-makers
* Able to plan productive routes and manage time efficiently
* Comfortable following opportunities from the first conversation through the sale
* Able to recognize when an opportunity is worth continuing to pursue and when it is time to move on

Experience in building materials, masonry, hardscape, landscape supply, stone, pavers, construction products, or contractor sales is strongly preferred, although we will consider candidates with strong outside B2B sales experience.

This position requires regular travel throughout the assigned market, particularly Pennsylvania and Delaware, so the candidate should be comfortable spending most working days in the field.

**About Stonehenge US**

Stonehenge US is a growing supplier and manufacturer of masonry, hardscape, and outdoor\-living products serving building\-material dealers throughout the Northeast.

We are continuing to expand our dealer network and are looking for someone who wants the opportunity to build a territory, develop long\-term dealer relationships, and grow their income as the territory grows.

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Our Heritage: An American Original Since 1977**


Founded on the Upper East Side of New York City by brothers Jay and Kevin McLaughlin, J.McLaughlin was built on a simple idea: great style feels personal.


From a single neighborhood shop to nearly 200 stores nationwide, we have always believed in being local and loyal—to our customers, our communities, and one another. Today, nearly 1,000 employees bring the brand to life across the country, from Maine to Maui.


For over 20 years, our corporate home has been in Greenpoint, Brooklyn, where creativity, craftsmanship, and collaboration continue to shape our next chapter.


Giving back is part of who we are. We support the communities we serve through local partnerships, charitable initiatives, and a belief that businesses should leave places better than they found them.

**Overview**


We are seeking a Logistics Coordinator to join our Product Development and Supply Chain team, reporting to our Director of Production. The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for coordinating purchase orders and inbound logistics activities from PO issuance through delivery of goods to the warehouse. This role will work closely with internal teams, vendors, freight forwarders, and warehouse partners to ensure timely and accurate shipment execution.


This position is primarily based in our Greenpoint, Brooklyn office and follows a hybrid schedule, dependent on role and business needs.

**About the role**

* Issue Purchase Orders and ensure all PO information is accurate and complete.
* Maintain and update POs, including changes to quantities, delivery dates, shipping details, and other key information.
* Work closely with freight forwarders to coordinate vessel bookings and shipment schedules.
* Review and approve vessel bookings to ensure alignment with required delivery timelines.
* Coordinate consolidation of goods across vendors and Purchase Orders to support efficient shipments.
* Monitor shipment status and key milestones from cargo readiness through vessel departure and final delivery.
* Coordinate with freight forwarders and warehouse teams to ensure timely delivery of goods into the warehouse.
* Maintain accurate PO, shipment, and delivery information in company systems.
* Maintain and publish transit lead\-time charts by country and port to support Production planning.
* Report shipment delays and potential delivery risks to the Production team on a weekly basis.
* Calculate and publish freight costs by product category and region to support costing, budgeting, and freight cost management.
* Proactively identify, communicate, and escalate potential shipment delays or logistics issues.
* Partner with Sourcing, Production, vendors, forwarders, and warehouse teams to ensure alignment on order and delivery status.

**What we are looking for**


Skills \& Requirements:

* 2\-4 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, import/export, or purchase order management.
* Experience working with international freight forwarders and coordinating ocean shipments.
* Strong organizational, communication, and follow\-up skills.
* High attention to detail and ability to manage multiple POs and shipments simultaneously.
* Proficiency in Excel and experience with ERP or PO management systems.

jobs.title: Recruiting Coordinator
jobs.description:
We're Scan.com. We're building America's national imaging network: the infrastructure that connects patients, providers, and payers to faster, better\-value diagnostic imaging. Thousands of patients move through our platform every day, and each is a real person waiting for an answer to a healthcare concern. We exist to get them that answer faster.


We manage the medical imaging pathway end\-to\-end. Providers order through a single point of entry, and from there, we run the entire medical diagnostic pathway. Managing the full pathway, rather than brokering pieces of it, is what lets us deliver imaging faster, at higher quality, and at a lower cost than the fragmented status quo.


We're looking for a **Recruiting Coordinator** at an exciting time. We've raised over $200m in funding to date, reached profitability, and are growing 100% year on year.


Millions of people wait too long for a diagnosis. Come help us fix that.

**WHAT YOU WILL BE GETTING INVOLVED IN**
----------------------------------------


As a **Recruiting Coordinator**, you'll support the candidate and new\-hire experience from the moment a requisition opens to an employee's first day on the job. This is a remote role at the heart of how we bring new people into Scan.com. You'll be the connective tissue between hiring managers, candidates, and new starters, making sure nothing falls through the cracks as we keep growing fast.


As a scale\-up business, you can expect your role to develop over time. Here are some of the types of things you could be getting involved in:

* Support the end\-to\-end talent coordination process, from requisition opening through to an employee's Day One
* Maintain and optimize Ashby, our applicant tracking system, so it works smoothly for hiring managers and candidates alike
* Schedule interviews across time zones, keeping the experience seamless for candidates and interviewers
* Coordinate internal interview loops and debriefs, keeping panels aligned and on schedule
* Generate offer documentation and start details for incoming employees
* Coordinate IT setup for new hires, making sure equipment and access are ready before Day One
* Manage pre\-onboarding communications so new hires feel informed and welcomed before they arrive
* Support onboarding operations through an employee's first day
* Help manage occasional requisitions, with the opportunity to build broader talent/recruitment experience over time

**THE TOP 5 THINGS WE WANT YOU TO ACHIEVE IN YOUR FIRST YEAR ARE**
------------------------------------------------------------------

* Every candidate who moves through our process has a smooth, well\-organized, and professional experience, from first interview to offer
* Ashby is running as a clean, reliable system of record, giving hiring managers and the Talent team accurate visibility into every open requisition
* New hires consistently arrive on Day One with their equipment, access, and onboarding plan fully in place, with zero last\-minute scrambles
* You've built trusted working relationships with hiring managers across the business, becoming the go\-to person for a smooth hiring process
* You've made our hiring experience more efficient by building in automations throughout the process without sacrificing quality or introducing bias

**WHAT YOU MIGHT BRING TO THE TABLE**
-------------------------------------


You don't need to tick all the boxes to apply for this role. Whether it's your first role or your fifth role, we believe everyone can add value, learn, and grow. However, these might be some of the ways you are currently adding value:

* Strong organizational skills and comfort juggling multiple moving parts (interviews, offers, onboarding tasks) at once
* Clear, professional written and verbal communication with candidates, hiring managers, and new hires
* Experience with an ATS (we use Ashby), calendar scheduling tools, and HR systems
* A drive to collaborate with your team on building a fair, consistent, and welcoming experience for every candidate who comes through our process
* A genuine interest in growing a career in talent/recruitment, with an eagerness to take on more responsibility over time
* Comfort working independently in a remote environment while staying closely coordinated with your team
* Experience using AI and/or automation tools to improve processes, distinguishing between the activities that need to have a human in the loop and the processes where technology can save time
* Experience integrating with ChartHop is a plus

**AI REQUIREMENTS**
-------------------


At Scan.com, AI isn't a side project; it's how we work. We expect everyone to use AI to think faster, remove drudgery, and multiply their output. What we care about is judgment: knowing when AI makes you sharper, when it doesn't, and how to use it responsibly around patient data. We'll assess this in the way that matters for this role, using the tier below. You don't need to be an engineer. You need to be someone who reaches for the best tool and gets more done because of it.

* Tier 2 — For this role, the expectation is that you are AI\-Amplified. AI is part of your daily workflow for drafting, analysis, and research, and you know how to check its output and use it responsibly with sensitive data. (most commercial, marketing, finance, people, and G\&A roles)


	+ AI is part of your daily default. You use it to draft, analyze, research, and pressure\-test your own thinking.
	+ You can show concrete examples where AI made your work meaningfully faster or better.
	+ You know its failure modes: you check its work, and you don't paste sensitive data into public tools.
	+ **Assessment:** We'll ask you to walk through how you'd use AI to tackle a real task from the role.

*One assessment principle across all tiers: we're testing judgment and adaptability, not whether you've memorized today's tools. Tools change quarterly; the ability to learn and apply them is what compounds.*

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Title:** Marketing Coordinator


**Reports To:** Director, Marketing


**Location:** Johns Creek


**Department:** Marketing  

  

**Position Summary:**  

The Marketing Coordinator at Nichiha plays a vital role in enhancing the customer experience through the management of promotional programs, samples, and a large annual trade show schedule. This role is responsible for ensuring customer\-facing initiatives are executed accurately, professionally, and on time, directly impacting brand perception, lead generation, and overall customer satisfaction. The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail\-oriented, proactive, and able to collaborate across the organization to deliver the best possible marketing experience.


**Responsibilities/Duties:**



Promotional and Sample Management: Oversee the organization and distribution of promotional materials and product samples, ensuring they are high quality, readily available, and aligned with market and customer needs.



Trade Show Coordination: Manage and coordinate a large annual schedule of trade shows and corporate events, working closely with Sales, Marketing, vendors, and other internal teams to ensure booth needs, materials, promotional items, shipping, staffing, and deadlines are properly planned and executed. Evaluate event success through lead generation, attendee engagement, feedback, and post\-event ROI.



Travel is not required for every trade show and will be on a case\-by\-case basis. However, the Marketing Coordinator is expected to be available to support scheduled events. The annual trade show schedule is established and communicated well in advance, generally at the beginning of the year.



Operational Oversight: Manage inventory for Nichiha’s promotional merchandise program, ensuring budget adherence, sourcing efficiency, inventory accuracy, and appropriate planning for upcoming events and initiatives.



Administrative and Reporting: Perform administrative duties including invoice reconciliation, expense tracking, and bi\-weekly department expense reports, maintaining financial and operational accuracy.

  


**Required Education and Experience:**



Educational Background: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Communications, or related field or equivalent professional level experience.



Professional Experience: Minimum of 2–3 years in marketing, event coordination, or a related role, preferably within a B2B environment.


**Required Skills/Abilities:**



Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail with the ability to accurately manage multiple events, deadlines, vendors, shipments, materials, and competing priorities.



Project Management: Excellent organizational and project management skills with a proven ability to manage multiple projects and a high\-volume event schedule simultaneously.



Collaboration and Communication: Demonstrated ability to work effectively with Sales, Marketing, vendors, and other departments across the organization to understand needs, communicate expectations, and ensure successful execution.



Customer Focus: Strong understanding of customer engagement and the impact of customer\-facing initiatives on brand perception, lead generation, and customer loyalty.



Initiative and Ownership: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities, anticipates needs, communicates potential issues early, and proactively identifies opportunities to improve processes and execution.



Analytical Acumen: Ability to measure and analyze event and promotional campaign effectiveness and use results to improve future marketing decisions.



Technical Proficiency: Competent in Microsoft Office Suite and Google Workspace, with experience in CRM and project management software preferred.



Adaptability: Capable of adjusting priorities and tactics in response to changing business needs, feedback, and event requirements.


Equal Opportunity Employer

jobs.description:
**We believe power is a promise \- a shared commitment to be there for others when it matters most.**
=====================================================================================================

  

For more than 65 years, we've turned big ideas into solutions that help protect homes, strengthen businesses and build a more resilient, efficient, sustainable energy future.

  

Ready to Power a Smarter World with us?

  

The **National Account Manager (NAM)** – The Home Depot is responsible for leading the strategic growth and profitability of the The Home Depot account, one of the company’s most critical national retail partners. This role owns the end\-to\-end relationship, driving revenue, market share, and brand presence across The Home Depot stores in both US and Canada.


The NAM serves as the primary interface with The Home Depot merchants and cross\-functional stakeholders, while coordinating internal teams to deliver best\-in\-class execution across sales, replenishment, merchandising, and marketing.

**Account Strategy \& Growth**

* Develop and execute a comprehensive account strategy aligned to The Home Depot priorities and category growth plans
* Deliver annual sales, margin, and market share targets
* Identify opportunities for assortment expansion, pricing optimization, and promotional effectiveness
* Lead Product Line Review (PLRs) and any business reviews with The Home Depot

**Customer Relationship Management**

* Build and maintain strong relationships with merchant, buyers, and cross functional partners.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for The Home Depot at a national level
* Influence decision\-making through data, insights, and category expertise

* Partner with The Home Depot to optimize: product assortment and lifecycle management, shelf placement (planograms) and in\-store execution, new product introductions and resets
* Leverage POS data and analytics to drive category insights and recommendations

**Sales Execution \& Forecasting**

* Develop accurate sales forecasts and demand plans in collaboration with internal and The Home Depot teams
* Monitor and analyze performance vs. forecast, identifying risks and opportunities

**Cross\-Functional Leadership**

* Collaborate internally with: Supply Chain, Demand Planning, Marketing, and Finance
* Ensure alignment and execution of account priorities across all functions

* Manage: Pricing strategy and margin performance, RFPs, contracts, and terms of sale, Issue resolution (inventory, service, product concerns)
* Ensure on\-time delivery, in\-stock performance, and service levels meet The Home Depot expectations

**Minimum Requirements:**

**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree Business, Marketing, Supply Chain, or related field or equivalent experience

**Work Experience**

* 3 years of experience in National or key account management

* Demonstrated success in developing new markets, launching new products, and rapidly increasing revenue.
* Award\-winning management or consulting track record.
* Market knowledge and experience in reproductive health is preferred.
* Strong time management skills.
* Effective coaching skills and openness to receiving coaching.
* Team\-oriented with excellent initiative and self\-motivation.

* Proven leadership with the ability to think strategically and execute tactically.
* Sense of urgency and focus on driving exceptional revenue growth.
* Capability to develop and execute strategic business plans.
* Confidence in achieving record\-breaking growth.
* Expertise in creating and implementing successful sales strategies.

Natera™ is a global leader in cell\-free DNA (cfDNA) testing, dedicated to oncology, women's health, and organ health. The Natera team consists of highly dedicated statisticians, geneticists, doctors, laboratory scientists, business professionals, software engineers and many other professionals from world\-class institutions, who care deeply for our work and each other. Competitive Benefits \- Employee benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life and disability plans for eligible employees and their dependents. **Job Description**
-------------------


Established nearly two centuries ago, FM is a leading mutual insurance company whose capital, scientific research capability and engineering expertise are solely dedicated to property risk management and the resilience of its policyholder\-owners. These owners, who share the belief that the majority of property loss is preventable, represent many of the world’s largest organizations, including one of every four Fortune 500 companies. They work with FM to better understand the hazards that can impact their business continuity to make cost\-effective risk management decisions, combining property loss prevention with insurance protection.


FM's Atlanta, Georgia Operation has an opening for a dynamic Account Manager in our Client Service Department. This position will perform insurance servicing and underwriting activities on existing accounts and new business. This position's primary function is to serve as the account team leader or manager of the account. Serve as key/primary interface with clients/brokers on all aspects of the account including insurance products and services, engineering, and claims services.


**This position is for an AM I to AM II, depending on the level of the candidate’s skill and experience. Varying levels of experience and qualifications will be considered.**


* Maintain a profitable book of business by effective use of sales techniques, client relationships, risk assessments, application of sound underwriting principles and creative use of underwriting resources.
* Ensure premium growth by retaining existing clients through value added service, by selling additional product lines and by establishing equitable terms and conditions on new accounts introduced by sales executives. Ensure policies accurately reflect both the insured’s and FM's intent of coverage.
* Provide professional advice and consultation to all clients on insurance coverages and risk management matters making them aware of the benefits derived from various products and services offered by FM.
* In coordination with Account Engineers, establish risk improvement priorities and support efforts to acquire client compliance with loss prevention recommendations.
* Protect FM's assets through creative use of company underwriting programs and adherence to published guidelines which include: Line setting techniques, judicious purchase of reinsurance (where warranted), timely issuance of policies, catastrophe aggregate analysis, MFL analysis and cross liability checks.
* Collect outstanding premium balances in a timely manner to meet the Operation’s goals and objectives.
* Continue professional development including maintaining necessary licensing. Continue to update knowledge of underwriting guidelines, policy forms, loss prevention practices and insurance industry developments.
* Provide leadership to the overall FM account team, ensuring that the Client Service Process is implemented effectively and efficiently.
* Handle change by prioritizing routine activities, workloads, and projects and through delegating to support staff as necessary.
* Evaluate manuscript coverage/wording requests: analyze existing policy language; degree and type of exposure; pricing; and develop additional policy language if warranted.

  

**Qualifications**  

  

  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; CPCU or ARM desired!
* Minimum 5\+ years FM experience or 5\+ years industry experience (broker, insurance, reinsurance company) in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* FM loss prevention engineering background desired.
* Previous experience as an Underwriter for FM is desired.
* Power Generation Loss Prevention or Underwriting experience is desired.
* Demonstrated effectiveness at accessing and influencing the decision maker.
* Strong familiarity with FM's client service process preferred.
* Experience in servicing/underwriting large property accounts of varying occupancies.
* Working knowledge of property insurance and forms, financial statements, general loss prevention engineering terms and concepts as well as business computer applications.
* Demonstrated above average ability in organization, problem solving, sales/negotiation, leadership and team building skills.
* Knowledge of internal systems and Microsoft Office products.

The final salary offer will vary based on geographic location, individual education, skills, and experience. The position is eligible to participate in FM’s comprehensive Total Rewards program that includes an incentive plan, generous health, and well\-being programs, a 401(k) and pension plan, career development opportunities, tuition reimbursement, flexible work, time off allowances, and much more!

jobs.title: Enterprise Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT REPAY
  

REPAY (“Realtime Electronic Payments” / NASDAQ TICKER: RPAY) is an established and fast\-growing publicly traded financial technology and payment processing company headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, with offices across the country. REPAY enables its customers to accept payments anytime, anywhere, and through any channel while providing a secure, seamless, and enjoyable payment experience for the end consumers. REPAY offers a comprehensive suite of electronic payment and funding solutions, including debit and credit card processing, ACH processing, Instant Funding, and electronic bill payment systems with full IVR, text, and mobile capabilities. The scalability of its products allows merchants of all sizes to add an instant arsenal of intelligent payment technology solutions to their businesses without significant development costs or infrastructure investments.


ABOUT THE ROLE


REPAY is seeking an Enterprise Technical Account Manager (eTAM) to serve as a trusted technical advisor to our strategic enterprise clients. The eTAM will own the ongoing technical relationship with an assigned portfolio of complex clients, developing a deep understanding of their technical environments, integrations, payment workflows, and business priorities.


This highly visible, client\-facing role partners closely with clients and internal teams to ensure the ongoing performance and success of REPAY solutions. The eTAM will provide technical guidance, manage complex technical issues and escalations, **and help clients optimize and expand their use of REPAY's technology.**

The eTAM will work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, and Sales to advocate for client needs and drive successful outcomes.


**RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Serve as a trusted technical advisor and key point of contact for assigned enterprise clients, developing a strong understanding of their business needs, technical environments, and use of REPAY solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with client stakeholders across technical, operational, and business functions.
* Provide technical guidance and consultation to clients throughout the lifecycle of the relationship, helping them navigate REPAY's products, capabilities, and integrations.
* Partner with clients and internal teams to understand technical needs, identify solutions, and support successful outcomes.
* Proactively identify potential technical risks, challenges, and opportunities within assigned client relationships and help drive appropriate action.
* Coordinate and support the resolution of complex technical issues and client escalations, engaging the appropriate internal resources as needed.
* Work cross\-functionally with Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Implementations/Sales Engineering, Client Success, Sales, and other teams to address client needs and priorities.
* Serve as an advocate for enterprise clients internally, helping communicate client feedback, business needs, technical requirements, and emerging priorities.
* Support the adoption and ongoing success of REPAY products and solutions within assigned enterprise accounts.
* Provide technical insight and support for client discussions, strategic initiatives, new opportunities, and evolving business needs.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen REPAY's enterprise client experience, technical account management practices, and internal processes.
* Maintain appropriate knowledge of REPAY's products, technology, integrations, and industry trends to effectively advise and support clients.
* Perform other responsibilities and support strategic initiatives as needed based on evolving client and business needs.
* Rotating assignment for technical off\-hours on\-call support of our strategic enterprise accounts.

**SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE NEEDED**

* 5\+ years of experience in Technical Account Management, Solutions Engineering, Implementation Engineering, Technical Consulting, Customer Engineering, or a similar client\-facing technical role.
* Experience supporting enterprise or complex clients within a SaaS, fintech, payments, or technology environment.
* Strong understanding of API\-based integrations, including REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data flows, and system\-to\-system integrations.
* Demonstrated ability to investigate complex technical issues and coordinate resolution across multiple technical teams.
* Strong technical aptitude with the ability to understand system architecture, integrations, and workflows.
* Proven ability to build trusted relationships with both technical stakeholders and senior business leaders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to translate complex technical concepts for non\-technical audiences.
* Strong project management, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple clients, initiatives, escalations, and competing priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive, ownership\-oriented approach.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across Product, Engineering, Support, Operations, Sales, and Account Management organizations.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**

* Experience within payments, fintech, financial services technology, or another highly integrated transaction\-processing environment.
* Knowledge of payment processing concepts, including card and ACH transaction flows, payment gateways, settlement, reconciliation, tokenization, and payment security.
* Experience with API testing and troubleshooting tools such as Postman.
* Familiarity with SQL, application logs, monitoring tools, or similar technical troubleshooting methods.
* Experience supporting high\-volume, mission\-critical platforms or complex enterprise integrations.
* Familiarity with PCI DSS and other security or compliance requirements applicable to payment proce

**About Us**

GrinderCrusherScreen has been in the heavy equipment business since 1973\. We sell, broker, and support grinders, crushers, screening plants, and the wear parts that keep them running. Our customers are land clearing crews, recycling yards, compost operations, and contractors across the country. When their machine is down, they call us.

We are small, fast moving, and we promote from the inside.

**The Role**

This is an entry level seat in our parts department. You do not need equipment experience. You need to be reliable, comfortable on the phone, and willing to learn a real trade.

You will spend your day talking to customers. Some of them call us. Most of them we call. Your job is to keep our existing customers buying and to make sure nothing falls through the cracks.

* Coordinate with our parts and technical team on lead times, shipping, and order status

* Dependable and on time, every day
* Clear, confident phone communication and comfort making outbound calls
* Basic computer skills and a willingness to learn our CRM (we will train you)

* A clear path into a sales career in an industry most people never hear about

The Community Outreach Partner supports the execution of localized, territory\-based community engagement and referral development for Flournoy Health Systems across Georgia. The Community Outreach Partner serves as a key representative of Flournoy Health Systems within the communities it serves. This role focuses on territory\-specific execution through direct relationship\-building with local organizations, referral sources, healthcare partners, and community stakeholders. The Community Outreach Partner is accountable for prospecting, outreach activity, referral source development, partnership follow\-up, territory visibility, and accurate CRM documentation to support a scalable, high\-performing referral pipeline across all assigned territories.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Execute territory\-based community outreach plans aligned with organizational growth and referral goals
* Build and maintain strong relationships with referral sources, community organizations, healthcare partners, and local stakeholders across assigned territories
* Identify, prospect, and develop new referral source opportunities to strengthen the local pipeline and expand territory reach
* Maintain regular in\-person outreach activity across the territory to ensure consistent visibility, relationship development, and local market presence
* Represent Flournoy Health Systems professionally in the community through meetings, events, networking opportunities, and partnership development efforts
* Support referral growth across all service lines, including Structured Family Caregiving, traditional caregiving, Pediatrics (skilled nursing and personal support), and Hospice care (and new services)
* Track all outreach activity, referral source engagement, follow\-up tasks, and partnership updates within the CRM in real time
* Operate fully within the CRM, maintaining accurate data, timely follow\-up, clear account ownership, and visibility into territory activity and pipeline development
* Follow established outreach workflows, processes, operating rhythms, and accountability standards to ensure consistency across territories
* Partner closely with leadership to communicate market feedback, local opportunities, relationship risks, and territory needs
* Monitor individual outreach performance, referral activity, and account development progress against defined goals
* Support territory planning and outreach initiatives tailored to local market needs and community dynamics
* Maintain a high level of responsiveness, organization, professionalism, and follow\-through in all relationship and referral development efforts
* Collaborate with peers across different regions and territories to support organizational growth and relationship transition when required
* Lead clinical recruiting efforts in designated areas, including actively sourcing and recruiting qualified LPNs and RNs, while supporting the growth and development of new service areas.
* Travel regularly throughout assigned territories across Georgia to support community presence and outreach execution

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree or higher preferred
* 3\+ years of experience in healthcare\-related sales, community outreach, relationship management, business development, field marketing, or related fields
* Fluency maintaining sales data in CRM. Experience with Hubspot is a plus.
* Healthcare experience required; home care, home health, hospice, or Medicaid\-funded programs strongly preferred
* Proven ability to build relationships, develop local partnerships, and support referral growth within assigned markets
* Strong communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills
* Professional, polished presence with the ability to engage a wide range of community and healthcare stakeholders
* Highly organized, self\-directed, and comfortable managing outreach activity across a defined territory
* Results\-driven with strong follow\-up, accountability, and work ethics
* Working knowledge of Medicaid and Medicare programs is a plus
* Valid driver’s license, reliable vehicle and ability to travel regularly across Georgia

jobs.title: Logistics Coordinator
jobs.description:
Description:
**About Us**


Family Entertainment Group (FEG), is a recognized industry leader in designing, developing, and operating world\-class family entertainment centers and amusement experiences. With a commitment to innovation and guest satisfaction, FEG partners with top brands and venues to create memorable experiences for families and guests of all ages. The Company provides turnkey outsourced facility management and arcade operations services for resorts, hotels, casinos, and amusement parks. Additionally, the Company owns and operates standalone family entertainment centers under the In The Game, Max Action, and Bonkers brands. The Company operates nearly 90 locations throughout the U.S.

**Position Summary**


The Logistics Coordinator is responsible for the hands\-on, point\-to\-point movement of shipments and equipment across all Family Entertainment Group locations, including obtaining freight quotes directly from manufacturers and setting up and coordinating wrap\-and\-roll freight for asset transfers. This is an individual\-contributor role: the Coordinator executes logistics tasks directly , and reports to the Parts \& Service Manager. When logistics volume allows, which is the minority of the role, the Coordinator also supports the Parts \& Service department with picking, packing, and shipping parts, fielding service calls, and general department assistance.

**Key Responsibilities – Logistics (Primary)**

* Coordinate all point\-to\-point logistics for shipments, equipment, and assets moving between manufacturers, corporate, and field locations.
* Obtain and compare freight quotes directly from manufacturers for shipments to individual locations, selecting the best combination of cost and transit time.
* Set up and coordinate wrap\-and\-roll freight for game and equipment transfers between locations.
* Book and schedule freight shipments for asset transfers between locations.
* Track shipments in transit and proactively communicate ETAs, delays, and exceptions to the field and Parts \& Service Manager and affected locations.
* Prepare and review shipping documentation, including bills of lading, freight quotes, and tracking information, for accuracy.
* Negotiate rates and service terms with carriers and freight forwarders to control shipping costs.
* Maintain organized records of freight quotes, carrier contacts, and shipment history.
* Identify and recommend process improvements to reduce freight costs, transit times, and shipping errors.

**Key Responsibilities – Parts \& Service Support (Secondary)**

* Assist with picking, packing, and shipping parts orders to field locations.
* Assist with receiving, organizing, labeling, and storing parts inventory, maintaining proper par levels.
* Take and route incoming service calls from field technicians.
* Assist field technicians with parts identification, handling, and ordering processes.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual inventory audits as needed.
* Assist with RMA (Return Merchandise Authorization) processing with manufacturers as needed.
* Provide general support to the Parts \& Service department as directed by the Parts \& Service Manager.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in logistics, freight coordination, shipping/receiving, or transportation coordination.
* Experience obtaining and comparing freight quotes; familiarity with LTL/FTL and wrap\-and\-roll freight preferred.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple shipments and deadlines at once.
* Clear, proactive verbal and written communication with carriers, vendors, manufacturers, and internal teams.
* Comfortable using basic computer and database tools (Excel, inventory or ERP systems).
* Willingness and ability to take on secondary duties, including picking/packing parts, fielding service calls, and general department support.
* Must be physically capable of lifting 50\+ lbs and working in warehouse conditions.
* High school diploma or GED required; additional training in logistics or supply chain is a plus.
