jobs.description:
**Full Time** position in 1 North Wacker Drive Chicago, IL, 60602  

  



**Job Title: Digital Marketing Sales Consultant**
  

*Location: Chicago, IL\-Hybrid/Remote*  

  

  



**If you've ever sold digital marketing to a small business owner and actually enjoyed it — this is the role you've been waiting for.**


**About Us:**


Predictive Sales AI builds AI\-powered websites and digital marketing tools specifically for home services contractors — HVAC companies, plumbers, roofers, landscapers. We help them show up online, generate more leads, and grow their business. Our clients are owner\-operators who work hard and need a marketing partner they can trust. That's where you come in.


**The Role:**


As a **Digital Marketing Sales Consultant** you'll be selling PSAI's websites, SEO, PPC, and Google Ads services to home services business owners across South Florida and beyond. This is a consultative sale — you're not order\-taking, you're helping contractors understand why their current marketing isn't working and showing them a better path.


You'll manage your own pipeline, run discovery calls, present proposals, and close deals. The sales cycle is typically 2–4 weeks. Most of your buyers are skeptical at first — they've been burned by marketing agencies before. Your job is to earn their trust fast and back it up with results.


**What You'll Do:**


* Prospect and develop your own pipeline through outreach, referrals, and warm leads from our marketing team
* Run discovery calls to understand a contractor's current marketing, pain points, and growth goals
* Present PSAI's digital marketing solutions — websites, SEO, PPC, Google Ads — and tailor proposals to each client's situation
* Handle objections from skeptical business owners who have been burned by agencies before
* Close deals and hand off to the client success team for onboarding
* Hit monthly revenue targets and maintain accurate pipeline records in CRM
* Stay current on digital marketing trends so you can speak credibly to clients about what actually works


**What We're Looking For:**


**Required:**


* 1–5 years of sales experience — digital marketing, SaaS, lead gen, or related field
* Comfortable selling to small business owners — you understand how they think and what they care about
* Strong phone and video presence — most of your outreach and demos will be remote
* Self\-starter who can manage their own pipeline without being micromanaged
* Genuine interest in digital marketing — you don't need to be a technical expert but you need to care about the product
* Based in or commutable to Boca Raton, FL for hybrid work schedule


**Bonus Points:**


* Experience selling to home services contractors (HVAC, plumbing, roofing, landscaping)
* Background selling SEO, PPC, Google Ads, or website services
* Sold for a digital agency, lead gen platform (Angi, HomeAdvisor), or local marketing company
* Familiar with contractor objections — ROI conversations, skepticism of digital marketing, long decision cycles


**Who Success Here:**


The reps who thrive at PSAI are hunters. They're comfortable picking up the phone, handling a tough objection, and following up until they get a yes or a no. They're also genuine — contractor owners can smell a pitch from a mile away, and the best reps here build trust quickly by being real.


* You're a closer — you know how to create urgency without being pushy
* You're resilient — rejection doesn't derail you, it refocuses you
* You're curious — you ask good questions and actually listen to the answers
* You're coachable — you want feedback and use it to get better
* You're hungry — you're motivated by commission and want to control your own earnings


**Why PSAI?**


* **You're selling something that works.** Our clients see real results — more calls, more leads, more booked jobs. That makes every sales conversation easier.
* **The market is massive.** There are hundreds of thousands of home services contractors in the US and most of them have terrible marketing. The opportunity is enormous.
* **You control your earnings.** Competitive base plus uncapped commission. The more you close, the more you make.
* **You're hybrid.** Work from home most of the time with regular check\-ins at our Boca Raton office. No five\-day commute.
* **You'll grow.** We're a growing company — reps who perform get more responsibility, better accounts, and a real career path.


**Sound like you?**


Apply with your resume and tell us in 2–3 sentences about the toughest SMB sale you've ever closed — what made it hard and how you got it done. That's all we need to get started.

maman \- Digital Marketing \& Content Coordinator


Role based in: New York, NY


Reports to: Digital Marketing \& Content Manager

  

maman is a french bakery, café and leading lifestyle brand founded in 2014 by owners elisa marshall \& benjamin sormonte, with locations across north america and canada. inspired by family traditions, and the highest quality ingredients, maman offers a selection of delicious baked goods {including their famous nutty chocolate chip cookie}, coffee, fresh breakfast, and lunch options spanning from hearty salads \& sandwiches to savory quiches. in addition to hosting intimate events, maman has partnered with leading brands for partnerships and activations. from baby showers and birthday parties to engagements, they're able to help celebrate customers \& make new beautiful memories.


We’re looking for a creative, organized, and digitally savvy Digital Marketing \& Content Coordinator to join our marketing team! Our ideal candidate is a natural storyteller and strong writer who is genuinely excited to make content, engage with our community, and help bring a distinct and engaging voice to maman’s digital channels. They are passionate about social media, hospitality, food, and digital culture, with a strong visual eye and an instinct for turning campaign priorities into social\-first content people want to watch, share, save, and talk about.


Reporting to the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager, this person will be responsible for the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social media channels, with a primary focus on content creation, copywriting, publishing, and community engagement. They will bring broader campaign strategy and messaging to life through Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, captions, and recurring content series, while helping shape maman’s social voice in a way that remains warm, playful, and unmistakably on\-brand. P.S. must love cookies!

  

What you'll do:


SOCIAL MEDIA \& CONTENT CREATION

* Own the day\-to\-day execution of maman’s organic social channels, including Instagram, TikTok, Pinterest, LinkedIn, and emerging platforms.
* Concept, capture, edit, schedule, and publish social content across Reels, TikToks, Stories, carousels, and recurring series with support from the Digital Marketing \& Content Manager.
* Create short\-form video content in cafés, at events, during store openings, and on set, ensuring footage feels polished, on\-brand, and platform\-native.
* Maintain the social media calendar and ensure all content is published accurately, on time, and aligned with campaign priorities.
* Handle daily community engagement across comments, DMs, tags, mentions, and guest questions.
* Coordinate with local marketing coordinators and café teams to source stories, capture content, and support market\-specific initiatives.
* Maintain an organized library of raw footage, edited content, photography, and approved social assets.

  

COPYWRITING \& BRAND VOICE

* Assist with short\-form video text, scripts, retail product descriptions, ad copy, community responses, and other guest\-facing messaging.
* Ensure all copy reflects maman’s established brand voice and feels clear, thoughtful, and engaging.
* Proofread guest\-facing content for tone, grammar, spelling, links, dates, pricing, location details, and overall accuracy.

  

DIGITAL MARKETING SUPPORT

* Support digital campaigns across social, email, website, app, partnerships, and other digital channels.
* Assist with seasonal launches, partnerships, photoshoots, promotions, events, new\-store openings, and broader brand initiatives.
* Help with email copy, ad copy, website copy, campaign recaps, research, and special projects as needed.

  

What we’re looking for:

* 2–3 years of experience in social media, content creation, digital marketing, or a related field.
* A strong portfolio demonstrating polished iPhone content capture, short\-form video editing, and social\-first storytelling. Experience with Adobe Premiere preferred.
* Experience maintaining a social content calendar and publishing across multiple channels.
* A visual eye and understanding of what makes content feel engaging, polished, and on\-brand.
* Have an understanding of brand voice and the ability to apply it consistently across different platforms.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to balance multiple drafts, deadlines, and priorities.
* Kind, passionate, curious, collaborative, detail\-oriented, highly accountable, and always willing to lend a hand.

  

Why work with us:

* Join a fast\-growing company committed to not just serving the best cookies and coffee, but building a national lifestyle brand.
* Comprehensive benefits package including healthcare, 401K, commuter benefits \& more.
* Support to help you settle into the role and learning opportunities to broaden your skill set.
* The opportunity to work across social media, content, hospitality, events, partnerships, and community\-building.
* Generous employee discount.
* A collaborative and creative team environment where new ideas are encouraged!
* Great opportunity to progress with maman, with internal mobility and growth encouraged when possible.


Keep in mind that maman is growing and developing every day. We all do a little bit of everything and like to roll up our sleeves to help a colleague out!


We are looking for awesome, hard\-working people that are all about creating the most memorable experience for every single maman customer.  

  

Thank you for your interest in maman and look forward to speaking with you!
